a: Umetzaftzefin veolin, shenneemar: "veheveti et hashshelishit baesh utzeraftim kitzrof et hakkesef uvechantim kivchon et hazzahav hu yikra vishmi vaani eene oto", vaalehem amra channa: "Adonai memit umechayye morid sheol vayyaal".
Bet hillel omrim: "verav chesed" — matte kelappe chesed. vaalehem amar david: "ahavti ki yishma Adonai et koli", vaalehem amar david kol happarasha kullah — "dalloti veli yehoshia".

Poshe yisrael begufan, ufoshe ummot haolam begufan — yordin legehinnam veniddonin bah shenem asar chodesh. leachar shenem asar chodesh — gufan kale, venishmatan nisrefet, veruach mefazzartan tachat kappot ragle tzaddikim, shenneemar: "veassotem reshaim ki yihyu efer tachat kappot raglechem".

Aval hamminin vehammasorot vehaeppikorsim shekkafru battora, veshekkafru bitchiyyayt hammetim, vesheppershu middarche tzibbur, veshennatnu chittitam beeretz chayyim, veshechatu vehechtiu et harabbim, kegon yarovam ben nevat vachaverav — yordin legehinnam veniddonin bah ledore dorot, shenneemar: "veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi vegomer".

Gehinnam kale vehen enan kalin, shenneemar: "vetzuram levallot sheol mizzevul lo". vechol kach lamma — mippene sheppashtu yedehem bizvul, shenneemar: "mizzevul lo", veen "zevul" ella bet hammikdash, shenneemar: "bano vaniti bet zevul lach", vaalehem amra channa: "Adonai yechattu merivav".
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar avin: ufenehem domin leshule kedera. veamar rava: veinhu mishshappire shappire bene machoza, umikkaryin "bene gehinnam".
Amar mar, bet hillel omrim: "verav chesed" — matte kelappe chesed, vehachtiv: "veheveti et hashshelishit baesh"! hatam, befoshe yisrael begufan.

Poshe yisrael begufan — veha amrat let lehu takkanta?! ki let lehu takkana — berov avonot. hacha — mechetza avonot umechetza zechiyyot, veit behu name avon defoshe yisrael begufan, la sagya leh delav "veheveti et hashshelishit baesh". veim lav, "verav chesed" — matte kelappe chesed. vaalehen amar david: "ahavti ki yishma Adonai".

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "ahavti ki yishma Adonai" — amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, ematay ani ahuva lefanecha — bizman sheatta shomea kol tachanunay. "dalloti veli yehoshia", af al pi sheddalla ani min hammitzvot — li nae lehoshia.
Poshe yisrael begufan, may nihu? amar rav: karkafta dela mannach tefillin. poshe ummot haolam begufan — amar rav: baavera.

Veshennatnu chittitam beeretz chayyim — amar rav chisda: ze parnas hammattil ema yetera al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim. amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol parnas hammattil ema yetera al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim eno roe ben talmid chacham, shenneemar: "lachen yereuhu anashim lo yire kol chachme lev".

Bet hillel omrim: "verav chesed" — matte kelappe chesed. hechi aved? rabbi eliezer omer: kovsho, shenneemar: "yashuv yerachamenu yichbosh avonotenu". rabbi yose bar chanina amar: nose, shenneemar: "nose avon veover al pesha".
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: maavir rishon rishon, vechen hi hammidda. amar rava: veavon atzmo eno nimchak. dei ikka rubba avonot — michashiv bahadayyhu.
Rava amar: kol hammaavir al middotav — maavirin lo al kol peshaav, shenneemar: "nose avon veover al pesha". lemi nose avon — lemi sheover al pesha.

Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chalash, al rav pappa leshayyole beh. chazyeh dachalish leh alma, amar lehu: tzevitu leh zevavdta. lesof ittefach, hava mikkesif rav pappa lemichzeyeh. amaru leh: may chazet? amar lehu: in, hachi hava, vaamar lehu hakkadosh baruch hu: hoil vela mokem bemilleh — la tekumu bahadeh, shenneemar: "nose avon veover al pesha", lemi nose avon — leover pesha.
"Lisherit nachalato", amar rabbi acha bar chanina: alya — vekotz bah: "lisherit nachalato" — velo lechol nachalato,
b: Lemi shemmesim atzmo keshirayim.
Rav huna rame, ketiv: "tzaddik Adonai bechol derachav", uchetiv: "vechasid bechol maasav"! battechilla — tzaddik, ulevassof — chasid.
Rabbi elazar rame, ketiv: "ulecha Adonai chased", uchetiv: "ki atta teshallem leish kemaasehu". battechilla — "ki atta teshallem kemaasehu", ulevassof — "ulecha Adonai chased".
Ilfay, veamri la ilfa rame, ketiv: "verav chesed", uchetiv: "veemet". battechilla — "veemet", ulevassof — "verav chesed".

"Vayyaavor Adonai al panav vayyikra". amar rabbi yochanan: ilmale mikra katuv, i efshar leomro. melammed shennitattef hakkadosh baruch hu kishliach tzibbur, vehera lo lemoshe seder tefilla. amar lo: kol zeman sheyyisrael chotin — yaasu lefanay kasseder hazze vaani mochel lahem.
"Adonai Adonai" — ani hu kodem sheyyechta haadam, vaani hu leachar sheyyechta haadam veyaase teshuva — "el rachum vechannun".
Amar rav yehuda: berit keruta lishlosh esre middot sheenan chozrot rekam, shenneemar: "hinne anochi koret berit".

Amar rabbi yochanan: gedola teshuva shemmekaraat gezar dino shel adam, shenneemar: "hashemen lev haam hazze veoznav hachebed veenav hasha pen yire veenav uveoznav yishma ulevavo yavin vashav verafa lo".
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: vedilma lifne gezar din? amar leh: "verafa lo" ketiv, ezehu davar shetztzarich refua — heve omer ze gezar din.
Metivi: hashshav bentayim — mochalin lo, lo shav bentayim — afillu hevi kol ele nevayot shebbaolam en mochalin lo! la kashya: ha — beyachid, ha — betzibbur.

Metivi: "ene Adonai elohecha bah" — ittim letova ittim leraa. ittim letova ketzad? hare shehayu yisrael reshaim gemurin berosh hashshana ufasku lahem geshamim muatim, lesof chazru bahen. lehosif alehen i efshar — shekkevar nigzera gezera, ella hakkadosh baruch hu moridan bizmannan, al haaretz hatztzericha lahen — hakkol lefi haaretz.

Ittim leraa ketzad? hare shehayu yisrael tzaddikim gemurin berosh hashshana ufasku alehen geshamim merubbin, lesof chazru bahen. lifchot mehen i efshar — shekkevar nigzera gezera, ella hakkadosh baruch hu moridan shello bizmannan, al haaretz sheenah tzericha lahen.
Letova miha, likreeh ligzar dinayyhu velosef lehu! shane hatam deefshar behachi.

Ta shema: "yorde hayyam booniyyot ose melacha bemayim rabbim. hemma rau maase Adonai vegomer vayyomer vayyaamed ruach seara vatteromem gallav. yachoggu veyanuu kashshikkor vegomer vayyitzaku el Adonai batztzar lahem vegomer yodu laAdonai chasdo vegomer".
Asa lahen simaniyyot keakkin verakkin shebbattora, lomar lach: tzaaku kodem gezar din — naanin, tzaaku leachar gezar din — enan naanin!
Hane name kichidin damu.
Ta shema: shaala belorya haggiyyoret et rabban gamliel, ketiv betoratchem: "asher lo yissa fanim", uchetiv: "yissa Adonai panav elecha"?

Nitpal la rabbi yose hakkohen. amar lah: emshol lacha mashal, lema haddavar dome — leadam shennoshe bachavero mane vekava lo zeman bifne hammelech, venishba lo bechayye hammelech, higgia zeman velo perao. ba lefayyes et hammelech, veamar lo: elboni machul lach, lech ufayyes et chavercha. hacha name, kan baaverot shebben adam lemakom — kan baaverot shebben adam lachavero.
Ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed:

a: Kan kodem gezar din, kan leachar gezar din! hacha name beyachid.

Ugezar din deyachid tannae hi. detanya, haya rabbi meir omer: shenayim shealu lammitta vecholyayn shave, vechen shenayim shealu laggardom liddon vedinan shave. ze yarad veze lo yarad, ze nitztzal veze lo nitztzal.

Mippene ma ze yarad veze lo yarad, ze nitztzal veze lo nitztzal? ze hitpallel venaana, veze hitpallel velo naana. mippene ma ze naana veze lo naana? ze hitpallel tefilla shelema — naana, veze lo hitpallel tefilla shelema — lo naana
Rabbi elazar amar: kan kodem gezar din, kan leachar gezar din. rabbi yitzchak amar: yafa tzeaka laadam ben kodem gezar din ben leachar gezar din.

Ugezar din detzibbur mi mikkera? veha katuv echad omer: "kabbesi meraa libbech", uchetiv: "ki im techabbesi banneter vetarbi lach borit nichtam avonech lefanay", may lav: kan kodem gezar din, kan leachar gezar din!
La, idde veidde leachar gezar din, vela kashya: kan bigzar din sheyyesh immo shevua, kan bigzar din sheen immo shevua.

Kidrav shemuel bar amme. deamar rav shemuel bar amme. veamri la, amar rav shemuel bar nachmani amar rav yonatan: minnayin ligzar din sheyyesh immo shevua sheeno nikra — shenneemar: "[v]lachen nishbati levet eli im yitkapper avon bet eli bezevach uvemincha".

Amar rava: bezevach uvammincha eno mitkapper — aval mitkapper betora. abbaye amar: bezevach umincha eno mitkapper — aval mitkapper betora uvigmilut chasadim. rabba veabbaye middevet eli kaatu. rabba daasak battora — chaya arbein shenin, abbaye daasak betora uvigmilut chasadim — chaya shittin shenin.

Tanu rabbanan: mishpacha achat hayta birushalayim shehayu meteha metin bene shemone esre shana. bau vehodiu et rabban yochanan ben zakkay, amar lahem: shemma mimmishpachat eli attem, dichtiv beh: "vechol marbit betcha yamutu anashim" — lechu veisku battora vichyu. halchu veasku battora vechayu. vehayu korin otah mishpachat rabban yochanan al shemo.

Amar rav shemuel bar inya mishshemeh derav: minnayin ligzar din shel tzibbur sheeno nechtam. eno nechtam?! vehachtiv: "nichtam avonech lefanay"! ella: af al gav shennechtam — nikra, shenneemar: "chaAdonai elohenu bechol korenu elav".
Vehachtiv: "dirshu Adonai behimmatzo"! hatam beyachid, hacha betzibbur.

Beyachid, emat? amar rabba bar avu: ellu asara yamim shebben rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim. "vayhi kaaseret hayyamim vayyiggof Adonai et naval" — asara yamim may avidtayyhu? amar rav yehuda amar rav: keneged eser legimot shennatan naval leavde david. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: ellu asara yamim shebben rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim.

Berosh hashshana kol bae haolam ovrin lefanav kivne maron. may "kivne maron"? hacha targimu: kivne immerana. resh lakish amar: kemaalot bet maron. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kachayaylot shel bet david.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: vechullan niskarin biskira achat. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, af anan name tenena: "hayyotzer yachad libbam hammevin el kol maasehem". may kaamar? illema hachi kaamar: divranhu lechulle alma umeyayched libbayyhu kahadaday — veha ka chazenan delav hachi hu! ella lav, hachi kaamar: hayyotzer roe yachad libbam umevin el kol maasehem.

Mishna al shishsha chodashim hashsheluchin yotzin: al nisan mippene happesach, al av mippene hattaanit, al elul mippene rosh hashshana, al tishre mippene takkanat hammoadot, al kislev mippene chanukka, veal adar mippene happurim.
Ucheshehaya bet hammikdash kayyaym — yotzin af al iyyayr mippene pesach katan.
Gemara velippeku name attammuz vetevet!
b: Deamar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida, may dichtiv: "ko amar Adonai tzevaot tzom harvii vetzom hachamishi vetzom hashshevii vetzom haasiri yihye levet yehuda lesason ulesimcha". kare lehu "tzom", vekare lehu "sason vesimcha"! bizman sheyyesh shalom — yihyu lesason ulesimcha, en shalom — tzom.
Amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: bizman sheyyesh shalom — yihyu lesason ulesimcha, yesh shemad — tzom, en shemad veen shalom — ratzu mitannin, ratzu en mitannin.
I hachi, tisha beav name? amar rav pappa: shane tisha beav, hoil vehucheplu bo tzarot. deamar mar: betisha beav charav habbayit barishona uvashsheniyya, venilkeda betar, venechersha hair.

Tanya amar rabbi shimon: arbaa devarim haya rabbi akiva doresh, vaani en doresh kemoto: "tzom harvii" — ze tisha betammuz shebbo huveka hair, shenneemar: "barvii betisha lachodesh vayyechezak haraav bair velo haya lechem leam haaretz vattibbaka hair". veammay kare leh "revii" — revii lechodashim.

"Tzom hachamishi" — ze tisha beav, shebbo nisraf bet elohenu. veammay kare leh "chamishi" — chamishi lechodashim. tzom hashshevii — ze shelosha betishri, shebbo neherag gedalya ben achikam. umi harago — yishmael ben netanya harago, lelammedcha sheshshekula mitatan shel tzaddikim kisrefat bet elohenu. veammay kare leh "shevii" — shevii lechodashim.

"Tzom haasiri" — ze asara betevet, shebbo samach melech bavel al yerushalayim, shenneemar: "vayhi devar Adonai elay bashshana hatteshiit bachodesh haasiri beasor lachodesh lemor. ben adam ketov lecha et shem hayyom et etzem hayyom hazze samach melech bavel el yerushalaym". veammay kare leh "asiri" — asiri lechodashim. vahalo haya rauy ze lichtov rishon? velamma nichtav kan — kede lehasedir chodashim ketiknan.

Vaani eni omer ken, ella: "tzom haasiri" — ze chamishsha betevet, shebbo bat shemua laggola shehukketa hair, shenneemar: "vayhi bishte esre shana baasiri bachamishsha lachodesh legalutenu ba elay happalit mirushalam lemor hukketa hair", veasu yom shemua keyom serefa.
Venirin devaray middevarav, sheani omer al rishon rishon veal acharon acharon, vehu omer al rishon acharon veal acharon rishon. ella shehu mone leseder chodashim, vaani mone leseder pureaniyyot.
Ittemar, rav verabbi chanina amri: batla megillat taanit. rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi amri: lo batla megillat taanit.
Rav verabbi chanina amri batla megillat taanit, hachi kaamar: bizman sheyyesh shalom — yihyu lesason ulesimcha, en shalom — tzom. vehanach name ki hane.
Rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi amri: lo batla megillat taanit — hane hu ditlinhu rachamana bevinyan bet hammikdash, aval hanach — kidkayymi kayymi.
Metiv rav kahana: maase vegazru taanit bachanukka belod, veyarad rabbi eliezer verachatz, verabbi yehoshua vesipper. veamru lahem: tzeu vehitannu al ma shehitannitem.
Amar rav yosef: shane chanukka deikka mitzva. amar leh abbaye: vetivtayl ihi vetivtal mitzvatah!
Ella amar rav yosef, shane chanukka demipparsam nissa.

Motev rav acha bar huna: bitlata betishri betelat adkarta min shetarayyay. sheggazra malchut yavan gezera shello lehazekir shem shamayim al pihem, uchesheggavra malchut chashmonay venitztzechum hitkinu sheyyehu mazkirin shem shamayim afillu bishtarot. vechach hayu kotvim: bishnat kach vechach leyochanan kohen gadol leel elyon.

Uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: lemachar ze porea et chovo venimtza shetar muttal baashpa, uvittelum, veoto hayyom asauhu yom tov. vei salka datach batla megillat taanit — kammayayta betul, achranyayta mosifin?!
Hacha bemay askinan, bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym.

a: Vetippok leh dehave leh yom shenneherag bo gedalya ben achikam! amar rav: lo nitzrecha ella leesor et shellefanav.
Shellefanav name, tippok leh dehave leh yom shelleachar rosh chodesh! rosh chodesh deorayyta, udeorayyta la bae chizzuk.

Detanya: hayyamim haelle hakketuvin bimgillat taanit asurin, ben lifnehem ben leacharehem. shabbatot veyamim tovim — hem asurim, lifnehen uleacharehen muttarin. ma hefresh ben ze laze? hallalu divre tora, veen divre tora tzerichin chizzuk. hallalu divre sofrim, vedivre sofrim tzerichin chizzuk.
Vetippok leh dehave leh yom shellifne yom shenneherag bo gedalya ben achikam! amar rav ashe: gedalya ben achikam divre kabbala hu, vedivre kabbala kedivre tora damu.

Metiv rav tovi bar matna: beesrim utemanya beh atat besorta tavta lihudae dela yeidon meorayyta. sheggazra malchut harshaa gezera shello yaasku battora, veshello yamulu et benehem, vesheyyechallelu shabbatot. ma asa yehuda ben shammua vachaverav? halchu venatlu etza mimmatronita achat shekkol gedole romi metzuyin etzlah.

Amra lahem: bou vehafeginu ballayla. halchu vehifginu ballayla, amru: e shamayim! lo achechem anachnu, velo bene av echad anachnu, velo bene em achat anachnu? ma nishtannenu mikkol umma velashon sheattem gozrin alenu gezerot kashot? uvittelum. veoto hayyom asauhu yom tov. vei salka datach batla megillat taanit — kammayayta betul, achranyayta mosifin?!

Vechi tema hacha name bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym — veha yehuda ben shammua talmido shel rabbi meir, verabbi meir batar hachi hava! ditnan: kele zechuchit shennikkevu vehittif letochan avar, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: yehuda ben shammua metamme mishshum rabbi meir,
b: Vachachamim metaharin.

Tannae hi. detanya: hayyamim haellu hakketuvin bimgillat taanit, ben bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym ben bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym — asurin, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym — asurin, mippene shessimcha hi lahem. en bet hammikdash kayyaym — muttarin, mippene sheevel hu lahem.
Vehilcheta batlu, vehilcheta lo batlu. kashya hilcheta ahilcheta! la kashya: kan bachanukka ufurim, kan bishar yome.
Al elul mippene rosh hashshana, veal tishri mippene takkanat hammoadot. kevan denafki lehu aelul, attishri lema lehu?
Vechi tema dilma abberu leelul, vehaamar rabbi chinnana bar kahana amar rav: mimot ezra veelach lo matzinu elul meubbar!
Lo matzinu — dela itzterich, ha itzterich — meabberinan leh.
Ha mikkalkal rosh hashshana! mutav tikkalkel rosh hashshana velo yitkalkelu kullehu moadot.
Dayka name, dekatane: al tishri mippene takkanat hammoadot, shema minna.

Veal kislev mippene chanukka, veal adar mippene happurim. veillu nitabbera hashshana yotzin af al adar sheni mippene happurim — la katane. matnitin dela kerabbi. detanya, rabbi omer: im nitabbera hashshana — yotzin af al adar hashsheni mippene happurim.
Lema beha kamippalgi, demar savar: kol mitzvot hannohagot bashsheni — nohagot barishon, umar savar: kol mitzvot hannohagot bashsheni — en nohagot barishon.
La, dechulle alma mitzvot hannohagot bashsheni — en nohagot barishon, vehacha beibbur shana kamippalgi. detanya: kamma ibbur shana — sheloshim yom, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: chodesh.
May shena sheloshim — deyadi? chodesh name yadi! amar rav pappa: man deamar chodesh, ratza — chodesh, ratza — sheloshim.
Heid rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum kehala kaddisha dirushalayim al shene adarim shemmekaddeshin otam beyom ibburehen.

Lememra dachaserin avdinan, melein la avdinan! leappoke middedaresh rav nachman bar chisda. heid rabbi simay mishshum chaggay zecharya umalachi al shene adarim, sheim ratzu laasotan shenehen melein — osin, shenehen chaserin — osin, echad male veechad chaser — osin, vechach hayu nohagin baggola. umishshum rabbenu amru: leolam echad male veechad chaser, ad sheyyiuoda lach shehukeba rosh chodesh bizmanno.
Shelachu leh lemar ukeva: adar hassamuch lenisan — leolam chaser.
Metiv rav nachman: al shene chodashim mechallelin et hashshabbat — al nisan veal tishri. i amrat bishlama zimnin male zimnin chaser — mishshum hachi mechallelinan.

a: Ella i amrat leolam chaser, ammay mechallelinan? mishshum demitzva lekaddesh al hariyyay.

Ikka deamri, amar rav nachman, af anan name tenena: al shene chodashim mechallelin et hashshabbat — al nisan veal tishri. i amrat bishlama leolam chaser — mishshum hachi mechallelinan, demitzva lekaddesh al hariyyay.
Ella i amrat zimnin male zimnin chaser — ammay mechallelinan? neabbereh haiddana, unekaddesheh limchar.
I deikkela yom sheloshim beshabbat — hachi name. hacha bemay askinan: deikkela yom sheloshim veechad beshabbat, demitzva lekaddesh al hariyyay.
Metiv rav kahana: keshehammikdash kayyaym mechallelin af al kullan, mippene takkanat hakkorban.
Middechullehu lav mishshum demitzva lekaddesh al hariyyay — nisan vetishri name lav mishshum demitzva lekaddesh al hariyyay.
I amrat bishlama zimnin male vezimnin chaser, mishshum hachi mechallelinan. ella i amrat leolam chaser, ammay mechallelinan? teyuveta.
Ki ata ulla, amar: abberu leelul. amar ulla: yadi chavrin bavlae may tevuta avdinan bahadayyhu!
May tevuta? ulla amar: mishshum yarkayya. rabbi acha bar chanina amar: mishshum mitayya.

May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu: yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat. man deamar mishshum mitayya — meabberinan. uman deamar mishshum yarkayya, leemat ka bae lehu — leureta, leureta tarach umayyte.

Uleman deamar mishshum yarkayya, leabbereh mishshum mitayya! ella: ikka benayyhu yom tov hassamuch lashshabbat ben millefaneha ben milleachareha. man deamar mishshum yarkayya — meabberinan, uman deamar mishshum mitayya — efshar beamme.
Uleman deamar mishshum mitayya, leabbereh mishshum yarkayya! efshar bechammime.
I hachi: may shena ledidan, afillu ledidhu name! ledidan chavil lan alma, ledidhu la chavil lehu alma.

Ini?! vehatane rabba bar shemuel: yachol keshem shemmeabberin et hashshana letzorech, kach meabberin et hachodesh letzorech? talmud lomar: "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim" — kaze ree vekaddesh.

Amar rava, la kashya: kan leabbero, kan lekaddesho. vehachi kaamar: yachol keshem shemmeabberin et hashshana veet hachodesh letzorech, kach mekaddeshin et hachodesh letzorech — talmud lomar: "hachodesh hazze lachem" — kaze ree vekaddesh.
Vechi ha deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: meayyeymin al haedim al hachodesh shennira bizmanno — leabbero, veen meayyeymin al haedim al hachodesh shello nira bizmanno — lekaddesho.

Ini?! veha shelach leh rabbi yehuda nesia lerabbi amme: hevu yodin shekkol yamav shel rabbi yochanan haya melammedenu: meayyeymin al haedim al hachodesh shello nira bizmanno — lekaddesho, af al pi shello rauhu, yomru "rainu"!
Amar abbaye, la kashya: ha benisan vetishri, ha bishar yarche.

Rava amar: ha detane rabba bar shemuel — acherim hi. detanya, acherim omrim: en ben atzeret laatzeret veen ben rosh hashshana larosh hashshana ella arbaa yamim bilvad. veim hayta shana meubberet — chamishsha.
Rav dimi minnehardea matne ippecha: meayyeymin al haedim al hachodesh shello nira bizmanno — lekaddesho, veen meayyeymin al haedim al hachodesh shennira bizmanno — leabbero.
May tama —
b: Hay michaze keshikra, hay la michaze keshikra.
Amar shemuel: yachelna letakkone lechulla gola.

Amar leh abba avu derabbi simlay lishmuel: yada mar hay milleta detanya besod haibbur: nolad kodem chatzot o nolad achar chatzot? amar leh: la. amar leh: middeha la yada mar — ikka mille achranyayta dela yada mar.
Ki selek rabbi zera, shelach lehu: tzarich sheyyehe layla vayom min hechadash.
Vezo sheamar abba avu derabbi simlay: mechashshevin et toladto. nolad kodem chatzot — beyadua shennira samuch lishkiat hachamma. lo nolad kodem chatzot — beyadua shello nira samuch lishkiat hachamma.
Lemay nafka minna? amar rav ashe: leachchoshe sahade.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav nachman: esrim vearbea shae mikkasse sehara. ledidan — shet meattika vetamne sere mechadta, ledidhu — shet mechadta vetamne sere meattika.
Lemay nafka minna? amar rav ashe: leachchoshe sahade.
Amar mar: tzarich sheyyehe layla vayom min hechadash. menalan? rabbi yochanan amar: "meerev ad erev".
Resh lakish amar: "ad yom haechad veesrim lachodesh baarev".
May benayyhu? abbaye amar: mashmaut dorshin ikka benayyhu.
Rava amar: chatzot layla ikka benayyhu.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav nachman: kol sefeka lekammeh shadenan. lememra dachamesar veshittesar avdinan, arbesar la avdinan.
Velebad name arbesar? dilma chasseru leav vechasseru leelul!

a: Tere yarche chassire kala it lehu.
Levi ikkela levavel bechadsar betishri. amar: besim tavshila devavlae beyoma rabba demareva. amri leh: ashed! amar lehu: lo shamati mippi bet din "mekuddash".
Machriz rabbi yochanan: kol hecha dematu sheluche nisan, vela matu sheluche tishre — libedu tere yome. gezera nisan attu tishre.

Rabbi ayyvu bar naggare verabbi chiyyay bar abba ikkelau lehahu atra dahava matu sheluche nisan vela matu sheluche tishre, veavdi chad yoma, vela amaru lehu vela midde. shema rabbi yochanan veikkefad. amar lehu: lav amari lechu hecha dematu sheluche nisan vela matu sheluche tishre libedu tere yome, gezera nisan attu tishre!
Rava hava regil dahava yatev betaanita tere yome. zimna chada ishtechach kevoteh.
Rav nachman yetev betaanita kulleh yome dechippure. leureta ata hahu gavra, amar leh: limchar yoma rabba bemareva.
Amar leh: mehecha at? amar leh: middimharya. amar leh: dam tehe acharito. kare aleh: "kallim hayu rodfenu".

Shelach leh rav huna bar avin lerava: kad chazet demashcha tekufat tevet ad shittesar benisan — abbera lehahi shatta vela techush la, dichtiv: "shamor et chodesh haaviv", shemor aviv shel tekufa sheyyehe bechodesh nisan.
Amar lehu rav nachman lehanhu nachote yamma: attun dela yaditu bikvia deyarcha, ki chazetu sehara demashlem leyoma — bairu chamira.
Emat mashlem — bachamesar. veha anan mearbesar mevaarinan! ledidhu dimgallu lehu alma, mearbesar mashlem.
b: Mishna al shene chodashim mechallelin et hashshabbat — al nisan veal tishri, shebbahen sheluchin yotzin lesureya, uvahen metakkenin et hammoadot. ucheshehaya bet hammikdash kayyaym — mechallelin af al kullan, mippene takkanat hakkorban.
Gemara al shene chodashim vetu la?! ureminhu: al shishsha chodashim hashsheluchin yotzin!
Amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: al kullan sheluchin yotzin mibbaerev — al nisan veal tishri, ad sheyyishmeu mippi bet din: "mekuddash".
Tanya name hachi: al kullan yotzin mibbaerev — al nisan veal tishri, ad sheyyishmeu mippi bet din: "mekuddash".
Tanu rabbanan: minnayin shemmechallelin alehen et hashshabbat? talmud lomar: "elle moade Adonai asher tikreu otam bemoadam".
Yachol keshem shemmechallelin ad sheyyitkaddeshu, kach mechallelin ad sheyyitkayyeymu — talmud lomar: "asher tikreu otam", al keriatam atta mechallel, vei atta mechallel al kiyyuman.

Ucheshehaya bet hammikdash kayyaym — mechallelin af al kullan, mippene takkanat hakkorban. tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu mechallelin af al kullan. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, amar lahen rabban yochanan ben zakkay: vechi yesh korban? hitkinu shello yehu mechallelin ella al nisan veal tishri bilvad.
Mishna ben shennira baalil, ben shello nira baalil — mechallelin alav et hashshabbat. rabbi yose omer: im nira baalil — en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat.
Maase sheavru yoter mearbaim zug, veikkevam rabbi akiva belod. shalach lo rabban gamliel: im meakkev atta et harabbim — nimtzeta machshilan leatid lavo.
Gemara may mashma dehay "alil" lishshana demiggalle hu? amar rabbi avahu, amar kera: "imrot Adonai amarot tehorot kesef tzaruf baalil laaretz mezukkak shivatayim".
Rav ushemuel. chad amar: chamishshim shaare vina nivreu baolam, vechullan nittenu lemoshe, chaser echad, shenneemar: "vattechasserehu meat meelohim".
"Bikkesh kohelet limtzo divre chefetz" — bikkesh kohelet lihyot kemoshe, yatzta bat kol veamra lo: "vechatuv yosher divre emet" — "velo kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe".

Vechad amar: banneviim lo kam, bimlachim kam. ella ma ani mekayyem "bikkesh kohelet limtzo divre chefetz" — bikkesh kohelet ladun dinin shebballev, shello beedim veshello behateraa. yatzta bat kol veamra lo: "vechatuv yosher divre emet" — "al pi shenayim edim vegomer".

a: Maase sheavru yoter mearbaim zug veikkevan rabbi akiva kulei. tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: chas veshalom sherabbi akiva ikkevan. ella shazpar roshah shel geder ikkevan, veshillach rabban gamliel vehoriduhu miggedullato.

Mishna av uveno sherau et hachodesh — yelchu. lo shemmitztarfin ze im ze, ella sheim yippasel echad mehen — yitztaref hashsheni im acher. rabbi shimon omer: av uveno vechol hakkerovin kesherin leedut hachodesh.

Amar rabbi yose: maase betoviyya harofe sheraa et hachodesh birushalayim, hu uveno veavdo meshucherar, vekibbelu hakkohanim oto veet beno ufaslu et avdo. ucheshebbau lifne bet din — kibbelu oto veet avdo, ufaslu et beno.
Gemara amar rabbi levi: may tama derabbi shimon, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe veel aharon beeretz mitzrayim lemor. hachodesh hazze lachem" — edut zo tehe keshera bachem.
Verabbanan? edut zo tehe mesura lachem.
Amar rabbi yose maase betoviyya harofe kulei. amar rav chanan bar rava: hilcheta kerabbi shimon. amar leh rav huna lerav chanan bar rava: rabbi yose umaase, veat amrat hilcheta kerabbi shimon?!

Amar lo: veha zimnin saggiin amarit kammeh derav hilcheta kerabbi shimon vela amar li vela midde! amar leh: hechi tanet? amar leh: ippecha. amar leh: mishshum hachi la amar lach vela midde. amar tavi bereh demari tavi amar mar ukeva amar shemuel: hilcheta kerabbi shimon.
Mishna ellu hen happesulin: hamesachek bekuveya, umalve beribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit, vaavadim. ze hakkelal: kol edut sheen haishsha keshera lah, af hen enan kesherin lah.
Gemara ha ishsha keshera lah — af hen kesherin lah. amar rav ashe: zot omeret, gazlan dedivrehem kesherin leedut ishsha.
Mishna mi sheraa et hachodesh veeno yachol lehallech — molichim oto al hachamor, afillu bemitta. veim tzode lahem, — lokchin beyadan maklot.
Veim hayta derech rechoka — lokchin beyadam mezonot. sheal mahalach layla vayom, mechallelin et hashshabbat veyotzin leedut hachodesh, shenneemar: "elle moade Adonai asher tikreu otam bemoadam".
Hadaran alach arbaa rashe shanim
Im enan makkirin oto — meshallechin immo acher lehaido. barishona hayu mekabbelin edut hachodesh mikkol adam. mishshekkilkelu habbayytosim, hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelin ella min hammakkirin.
Gemara may acher? chad,
b: Vechad mi meheman?! vehatanya: maase shebba hu veedav immo lehaid alav! amar rav pappa: may "acher" — zug acher.

Hachi name mistabbera, dei la tema hachi — "im enan makkirin oto", may "oto"? illema "oto" chad — vechad mi meheman? "mishpat" ketiv beh. ella may "oto" — oto hazzug, hachi name: may "acher" — zug acher.
Vechad la meheman? vehatanya: maase berabbi nehoray shehalach etzel haed lehaid alav beshabbat beusha!

Amri: rabbi nehoray sahada acharina hava bahadeh, veha dela chashev leh — mishshum kevodo shel rabbi nehoray. rav ashe amar: rabbi nehoray sahada acharina hava beusha, vaazal rabbi nehoray leitzterofe bahadeh.
I hachi, may lememra? mahu detema: missefeka la mechallelinan shabbeta, ka mashma lan.

Ki ata ulla, amar: kaddeshu leyarcha bemareva. amar rav kahana: la mibbaya ulla, degavra rabba hu, dimheman. ella afillu inish dealma name meheman. may tama? kol milleta daavida leiggalloye — la meshakkeri ba inashe. tanya name hachi: ba echad besof haolam veamar kiddeshu bet din et hachodesh — neeman.

Barishona hayu mekabbelin edut hachodesh mikkol adam vechulei. tanu rabbanan: ma kilkul kilkelu habbayytosin? paam achat bikkeshu bayytosin lehateot et chachamim, sachru shene bene adam bearba meot zuz, echad mishshellanu, veechad mishshellahem.

Shellahem — heid eduto veyatza. shellanu, amru lo: emor ketzad raita et hallevana! amar lahem: ole hayiti bemaale adummim, ureitiv shehu ravutz ben shene selaim, rosho dome leegel, oznav domin ligdi, karnav domot litzvi, uzenavo munnachat lo ben yarchotav, vehetzatzti bo venirtati venafalti laachoray. veim en attem maaminim li — hare matayim zuz tzerurin li bisdini.
Amru lo: mi hizkikcha lechach? amar lahem: shamati shebbikkeshu bayytosim lehateot et chachamim, amarti: elech ani veodia lahem, shemma yavou bene adam sheenam mehugganin veyatu et chachamim.
Amru lo: matayim zuz — netunin lecha bemattana, vehassochercha yimmatach al haammud. beotah shaa hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelin ella min hammakkirin.
Mishna barishona hayu massiin massuot. mishshekkilkelu hakkutim, hitkinu sheyyehu sheluchin yotzin.

Ketzad hayu massiin massuot? meviin kelonsaot shel erez arukkin, vekanim, vaatze shemen, uneoret shel pishtan. vechorech bimshicha veole lerosh hahar umatztzit bahen et haur. umolich umevi umaale umorid, ad shehu roe et chavero shehu ose ken berosh hahar hashsheni, vechen berosh hahar hashshelishi.

Umeayin hayu massiin massuot? mehar hammishcha lesarteva, umissarteva ligrofina, umiggerofina lechavvran, umechavvran levet biltin, umibbet biltin lo zazu mishsham, ella molich umevi umaale umorid ad shehaya roe kol haggola lefanav kimdurat haesh.
Gemara may mashma demassiin" lishshana dikod hu? dichtiv: "vayyissaem david vaanashav", umetargeminan: veokdinun david.
Tanu rabbanan: en massiin massuot ella al hachodesh shennira bizmanno lekaddesho. veematay massiin — leor ibburo.

Lememra deachaser avdinan, ammale la avdinan. may tama? amar rabbi zera: gezera mishshum rosh chodesh chaser shechal lihyot beerev shabbat. emat avdi — beappoke shabbeta. dei amrat naaved name amalle — atu

a: Lemite, amri: hay chaser hu, vehay dela avid meetmol, mishshum dela efshar. o dilma male hu, uvizmanno avadu.
Velebed ben ammale ben achaser, vechi mikkela rosh chodesh beerev shabbat la lebed kelal. vechevan dela avdinan motzae shabbat veavdinan ammale — midda yadi dechaser hu!
Afillu hachi atu lemite, amri: hay male hu, vehay dela avdi — ittenose hu deittenusoy.
Velebed ammale, vela lebed achaser kelal! amar abbaye: mishshum bittul melacha laam shene yamim.

Ketzad hayu massiin massuot — meviin kelonsot kulei. amar rav yehuda, arbaa mine arazim hen: erez, katrom, etz shemen, uverosh. katrom, amar rav: adra. deve rabbi shela amri: mavliga, veamri la zo gulemesh.

Ufeliga derabba bar rav huna. deamar rabba bar rav huna, amri be rav: asara mine arazim hem, shenneemar: "etten bammidbar erez shitta vahadas veetz shamen asim baarava berosh tidhar uteashshur yachdav". erez — arza, shitta — turenita, hadas — assa, etz shemen — afarsema, berosh — berata, tidhar — shaga, teashshur — shurivna.

Hane shiva havu! ki ata rav dimi, amar: hosifu alehem allonim, almonim, almuggin. allonim — buteme, almonim — balute, almuggin — kesita. ikka deamri: arunnim, armonim, almuggin. arunnim — are, armonim — duleve, almuggin — kesita.
"Vetzi addir lo yaavrennu" — amar rav: zo bureni gedola.

Hechi avdi? mayytu shet alfe gavre bitresar yarche shatta, veamri la teresar alfe gavre beshitta yarche shatta, vetaani la chala ad deshachna. venachet bar amoray vekatar atune dechittana bichsita, vekatar lehu bisfinta. venatli chala veshadu levaray, vechamma demiddalya — akra umatya.
Umachlef al chad teren bechaspa. telat parvota havyayn: tarte be romae vachada deve farsae. deve romae massekan kesita, deve farsae massekan marganyayta, umikkaryay: parvota demashmehig.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kol shitta veshitta shennatlu goyim mirushalayim, atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran lah, shenneemar: "etten bammidbar erez shitta", veen midbar ella yerushalayim, shenneemar: "tziyyon midbar hayta vegomer".
Veamar rabbi yochanan: kol hallomed tora veeno melammedah, dome lahadas bammidbar. ikka deamri: kol hallomed tora umelammedah bimkom sheen talmide chachamim — dome lahadas bammidbar, dechabbiv.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: oy lahem laggoyim, sheen lahem takkana, shenneemar: "tachat hannechoshet avi zahav vetachat habbarzel avi chesef vetachat haetzim nechoshet vetachat haavanim barzel". tachat rabbi akiva vachaverav may meviin! vaalehem hu omer: "venikketi damam lo nikketi".
Umeayin hayu massiin massuot kulei umibbet biltin. may bet biltin? amar rav:
b: Zo beram.
May gola? amar rav yosef: zo pumebdita. may kimdurat haesh? tana: kol echad veechad notel avuka beyado veole lerosh gaggo.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af charim ucheyayr ugedor vechavroteha. ikka deamri: bene uvene havo kayymi. ikka deamri: lehach gisa deeretz yisrael havo kayymi. mar chashev dehay gisa, umar chashev dehay gisa.
Amar rabbi yochanan: ben kol achat veachat shemone parsaot. kamma havu lehu? telatin vetarten, veha haiddana tuva havu! amar abbaye: istattome istattum lehu darche.
Dichtiv: "lachen hinni sach et darkech bassirim", rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha, dichtiv: "netivotay ivva".
Mishna chatzer gedola hayta birushalayim uvet yazek hayta nikret, ulesham kol haedim mitkannesin. uvet din bodkin otam sham. useudot gedolot osin lahem, bishvil sheyyehu regilin lavo.
Barishona lo hayu zazin mishsham kol hayyom. hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken sheyyehu mehallechin alpayim amma lechol ruach.
Velo ellu bilvad, ella af chachama habbaa leyaylled, vehabba lehatztzil min haddeleka umin haggayis umin hannahar umin hammappolet — hare ellu keanshe hair, veyesh lahem alpayim lechol ruach.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: "bet yazek" tenan, o "bet yazek" tenan? "bet yazek" tenan — lishshana mealleya hu, dichtiv: "vayazzekehu vaysakkelehu", o dilma "bet yazek" tenan — lishshana detzaara hu, kedichtiv: "vehu asur bazikkim"?
Amar abbaye, ta shema: seudot gedolot hayu osin lahem sham, kede sheyyehu regilim lavo. dilma tarte havo avdi behu.

Mishna ketzad bodkin et haedim? zug shebba rishon — bodkin oto rishon. umachnisin et haggadol shebbahen, veomrin lo, emor ketzad raita et hallevana: lifne hachamma, o leachar hachamma? litzfonah, o lidromah? kamma haya gavoah, uleayin haya note, vechamma haya rachav. im amar lifne hachamma — lo amar kelum.

Veachar kach hayu machnisin et hashsheni uvodkin oto. im nimtzeu divrehem mechuuonim — edutan kayyemet. ushear kol hazzugot, shoalin otan rashe devarim. lo shehayu tzerichim lahem, ella kede shello yetzu befache nefesh, bishvil sheyyehu regilim lavo.
Gemara hayeynu lifne hachamma, hayeynu litzfonah; hayeynu leachar hachamma, hayeynu lidromah! amar abbaye: pegimatah — lifne hachamma, o leachar hachamma? im amar lifne hachamma — la amar kelum.

Deamar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "hameshel vafachad immo ose shalom bimromav", meolam lo raata chamma pegimatah shel levana, velo pegimatah shel keshet. pegimatah shel levana — dechalsha data. pegimatah shel keshet — dela lemru ovde hachamma

a: Gire ka meshaddeyay.
Kamma haya gavoah, uleayin haya note kulei. tana chada: litzfonah — devarav kayyaymin, lidromah — lo amar kelum. vehatanya ippecha: lidromah — devarav kayyaymin, litzfonah — lo amar kelum.
La kashya: kan, bimot hachamma. kan, bimot haggeshamim.
Tanu rabbanan: echad omer gavoah shete mardeot, veechad omer shalosh — edutan kayyemet. echad omer shalosh, veechad omer chamesh — edutan betela. aval mitztarfin leedut acheret.
Tanu rabbanan: reinuhu bemayim, reinuhu baashashit, reinuhu beavim — en meidin alav. chetzyo bemayim, chetzyo beavim, chetzyo baashashit — en meidin alav.
Hasheta kullo amrat la, chetzyo mibbaya?! ella hachi kaamar: chetzyo bemayim chetzyo barakia, chetzyo beavim chetzyo barakia, chetzyo baashashit chetzyo barakia — en meidin.
Tanu rabbanan: reinuhu veshuv lo reinuhu — en meidin alav. kol hachi chazu le veazli?!
Amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: reinuhu meelenu, veshavnu liroto middatenu, velo reinuhu — en meidin alav, may tama — emor kovita deeva bealma hu dechaze.
Mishna rosh bet din omer: "mekuddash", vechol haam onin acharav: "mekuddash mekuddash". ben shennira bizmanno, ben shello nira bizmanno — mekaddeshin oto.
Rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: im lo nira bizmanno — en mekaddeshin oto, shekkevar kiddeshuhu shamayim.
Gemara rosh bet din vechulei. menahane mille? amar rabbi chiyyay bar gamda amar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rabbi: amar kera "vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai" — mikkan sherosh bet din omer "mekuddash".
Vechol haam onin acharav "mekuddash mekuddash". menalan? amar rav pappa: amar kera "asher tikreu otam", keri beh attem. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: "elle hem moaday", hem yomru moaday.
"Mekuddash mekuddash" tere zimne lema li? dichtiv: "mikrae kodesh".
Rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: im lo nira bizmanno — en mekaddeshin oto. tanya, pelemo omer: bizmanno — en mekaddeshin oto, shello bizmanno — mekaddeshin oto.

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: ben kach uven kach en mekaddeshin oto, shenneemar: "vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim" — shanim atta mekaddesh, vei atta mekaddesh chodashim. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi elazar berabbi tzadok.
Amar abbaye, af anan name tenena: rauhu bet din vechol yisrael, nechkeru haedim velo hispiku lomar "mekuddash" ad shechashecha — hare ze meubbar. meubbar — in, mekuddash — la.
Meubbar itztericha leh, salka datach amena: hoil verauhu bet din vechol yisrael, ipparsema vela liberu, ka mashma lan.
Mishna demut tzurot levana hayu lo lerabban gamliel betavla uvechotel baaliyyayto, shebbahen mare et hahedyotot, veomer: hachaze raita o kaze.
Gemara umi shere? vehachtiv: "lo taasun itti" — lo taasun kidmut shammashayy.

Amar abbaye: la asra tora ella shammashin sheefshar laasot kemotan, kidtanya: lo yaase adam bayit tavnit hechol, achsadra tavnit ulam, chatzer keneged azara, shulchan keneged shulchan, menora keneged menora. aval ose
b: Shel chamishsha veshel shishsha veshel shemona. veshel shiva — lo yaase, afillu shel shear mine mattachot. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: af shel etz lo yaase, kederech sheasu malche bet chashmonay.
Amru lo: mishsham reayay?! shappudin shel barzel hayu vechippum bevaatz. heeshiru — asaum shel kesef, chazru heeshiru — asaum shel zahav.

Veshammashin shei efshar laasot kemotan mi shere? vehatanya: "lo taasun itti" — lo taasun kidmut shammashayy hameshammeshin lefanay bammarom! amar abbaye: lo asra tora ella demut arbaa panim bahade hadade.

Ella meatta partzuf adam lechodeh tishtere? allema tanya: kol happartzufot muttarin chutz mippartzuf adam! amar rav huna bereh derav idi: mippirkeh deabbaye shemia li: "lo taasun itti" — lo taasun oti.

Ushear shammashin mi shere? veha tanya "lo taasun itti" — lo taasun kidmut shammashayy hammeshammeshin lefanay bammarom, kegon ofannim userafim vechayyot hakkodesh umalache hashsharet! amar abbaye: lo asra tora ella shammashin shebbammador haelyon.
Veshebbammador hattachton mi shere? vehatanya: "asher bashshamayim" — lerabbot chamma ulevana kochavim umazzalot, "mimmaal" — lerabbot malache hashsharet! ki tanya hahi — leovdam.
I leovdam, afillu shilshul katan name! in hachi name, detanya: "asher baaretz" — lerabbot harim ugevaot yammim uneharot afikim vegeayot, "mittachat" — lerabbot shilshul katan.
Vaasiyyay geredta mi shere? vehatanya: "lo taasun itti" — lo taasun kidmut shammashayy hameshammeshin lefanay, kegon chamma ulevana kochavim umazzalot.
Shane rabban gamliel, daacherim asu lo. veha rav yehuda, daacherim asu lo, vaamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, sammi eneh deden!
Hatam, chotamo bolet hava, umishshum chashada. kidtanya: tabbaat, chotamo bolet — asur lehannichah umuttar lachtom bah. chotamo shokea — muttar lehannichah veasur lachtom bah.

Umi chayyshinan lachashada? veha hahi be chenishta deshaf vitev binhardea, dahava beh inderata, vahavo ayyli rav ushemuel vaavu dishmuel velevi umetzallu hatam, vela chayyshi lachashada! rabbim shane.
Veha rabban gamliel yachid hu? kevan denasi hu — shechichi rabbim gabbeh. ibbaet ema: difrakim hava.
Veibbaet ema: lehitlammed avad, uchetiv: "lo tilmad laasot" — aval atta lamed lehavin ulehorot.
Mishna maase shebbau shenayim veamru: reinuhu shacharit bammizrach,

a: Vearvit bammaarav. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: ede sheker hem. keshebbau leyavne kibbelan rabban gamliel.
Veod, bau shenayim veamru: reinuhu bizmanno, uvelel ibburo lo nira, vekibbelan rabban gamliel.

Amar rabbi dosa ben horkinas: ede sheker hen, heach meidim al haishsha sheyyalda ulemachar keresah ben shinneha? amar lo rabbi yehoshua: roe ani et devarecha. shalach lo rabban gamliel: gozrani alecha shettavo etzli bemakkelcha uvimotecha beyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot becheshbonecha.

Halach umetzao rabbi akiva metzer, amar lo: yesh li lilmod shekkol ma sheasa rabban gamliel asuy, shenneemar: "elle moade Adonai mikrae kodesh asher tikreu otam", ben bizmannan ben shello bizmannan — en li moadot ella ellu.

Ba lo etzel rabbi dosa ben horkinas, amar lo: im bain anu ladun achar bet dino shel rabban gamliel, tzerichin anu ladun achar kol bet din uvet din sheamad mimot moshe vead achshav. shenneemar: "vayyaal moshe veaharon nadav vaavihu veshivim mizzikne yisrael", velamma lo nitparshu shemotan shel zekenim? ella lelammed shekkol shelosha ushelosha sheamdu bet din al yisrael — hare hu kevet dino shel moshe.

Natal maklo umeotav beyado, vehalach leyavne etzel rabban gamliel bayyom shechal yom hakkippurim lihyot becheshbono. amad rabban gamliel uneshako al rosho, amar lo: bo beshalom rabbi vetalmidi! rabbi — bechochma, vetalmidi — shekkibbalta et devaray.
Gemara tanya, amar lahem rabban gamliel lachachamim: kach mekubbelani mibbet avi abba — peamim shebba baarukka ufeamim shebba biktzara.
Amar rabbi yochanan: may tama deve rabbi, dichtiv: "asa yareach lemoadim shemesh yada mevoo" — shemesh hu deyada mevoo, yareach lo yada mevoo.

Rabbi chiyyay chazye lesehara dahava kae betzafra deesrim vetisha. shekal kala petak beh, amar: leureta baenan lekaddoshe bach, veat kayymat hacha?! zil ikkassi. amar leh rabbi lerabbi chiyyay: zil leen tav vekaddesheh leyarcha, ushelach li simana: "david melech yisrael chay vekayyam".

Tanu rabbanan: paam achat nitkashsheru shamayim beavim, veniret demut levana beesrim vetisha lachodesh. kisvurim haam lomar rosh chodesh, uvikkeshu bet din lekaddesho. amar lahem rabban gamliel: kach mekubbelani mibbet avi abba — en chiddushah shel levana pechuta meesrim vetisha yom umechetza ushene shelishe shaa veshivim ushelosha chalakim.
Veoto hayyom meta immo shel ben zaza, vehispidah rabban gamliel hesped gadol. lo mippene sheruya lechach, ella kede sheyyedu haam shello kiddeshu bet din et hachodesh.

Halach rabbi akiva umetzao metzer kulei. ibbaya lehu: mi metzer? rabbi akiva metzer, o rabbi yehoshua metzer? ta shema, detanya: halach rabbi akiva umetzao lerabbi yehoshua keshehu metzer, amar lo: [rabbi] mippene ma atta metzer? amar lo: rabbi akiva, rauy lo sheyyippol lammitta shenem asar chodesh, veal yigzor alav gezera zo.
Amar lo: rabbi, tarsheni lomar lefanecha davar echad shellimmadtani. amar lo: emor. amar lo: hare hu omer "otam" "otam" "otam" shalosh peamim.
"Attem" — afillu shoggin, "attem" — afillu mezidin, "attem" — afillu mutein. ballashon hazze amar lo: akiva nichamtani, nichamtani.
Ba lo etzel rabbi dosa ben horkinas kulei. tanu rabbanan: lamma lo nitparshu shemotam shel zekenim hallalu? shello yomar adam: peloni kemoshe veaharon? peloni kenadav vaavihu? peloni keeldad umedad?

Veomer: "vayyomer shemuel el haam Adonai asher asa et moshe veet aharon". veomer: "vayyishlach Adonai et yerubbaal veet bedan veet yiftach veet shemuel". "yerubbaal" — ze gidon, velamma nikra shemo yerubbaal — sheasa meriva im habbaal. "bedan" — ze shimshon, velamma nikra shemo bedan — deate middan. yiftach — kemashmao.
b: Veomer: "moshe veaharon bechohanav ushemuel bekore shemo", shakal hakkatuv shelosha kalle olam kishlosha chamure olam,

Lomar lach: yerubbaal bedoro — kemoshe bedoro, bedan bedoro — keaharon bedoro, yiftach bedoro — kishmuel bedoro. lelammedcha: sheafillu kal shebbakkallin venitmanna parnas al hatztzibbur — hare hu keabbir shebbaabbirim.

Veomer: "uvata el hakkohanim haleviyyim veel hashshofet asher yihye bayyamim hahem", vechi taale al datecha sheadam holech etzel haddayyayn shello haya beyamav? ha en lecha lelech ella etzel shofet shebbeyamav. veomer: "al tomar me haya shehayyamim harishonim hayu tovim meelle".

Natal maklo umeotav beyado. tanu rabbanan: kevan sheraa oto, amad mikkisseo uneshako al rosho, amar lo: shalom alecha rabbi vetalmidi! rabbi — shellimmadtani tora barabbim, vetalmidi — sheani gozer alecha gezera veatta mekayyeymah ketalmid. ashre haddor shehaggedolim nishmaim lakketannim, kal vachomer ketannim laggedolim.
Kal vachomer?! chiyyuva hu! ella: mittoch shehaggedolim nishmaim lakketannim — nosin ketannim kal vachomer beatzman.
Hadaran alach im enan makkirin
Rauhu bet din vechol yisrael, nechkeru haedim velo hispiku lomar "mekuddash" ad shechashecha — hare ze meubbar.

Rauhu bet din bilvad — yaamdu shenayim veyaidu bifnehem, veyomru: "mekuddash mekuddash". rauhu shelosha vehen bet din — yaamdu hashshenayim veyoshivu mechaverehem etzel hayyachid, veyaidu bifnehem, veyomru: "mekuddash mekuddash", sheen hayyachid neeman al yede atzmo.
Gemara lema li lemitne rauhu bet din vechol yisrael? itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil verauhu bet din vechol yisrael — ipparsema la vela liabberu, ka mashma lan.
Vechevan ditna leh rauhu bet din vechol yisrael — nechkeru haedim lema li! hachi kaamar: i name nechkeru haedim velo hispiku lomar "mekuddash" ad shechashecha — hare ze meubbar.
Vechevan ditna ad shechashecha hare ze meubbar — lema li lemitneyay chakirat haedim kelal?

Itzterich, salka datach amena: tehve chakirat edim kitchillat din, umekuddash mekuddash" kigmar din, ulekaddesheh belelya, midde dehave addine mamonot, ditnan: dine mamonot danin bayyom vegomrin ballayla — hacha name mekaddeshin belelya, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name? amar kera: "ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov", emat have "chok" — bigmar din, veka kare leh rachamana "mishpat", ma mishpat bayyom — af hacha name bayyom.
Rauhu bet din — yaamdu shenayim veyaidu bifnehem. veammay? lo tehe shemia gedola meriyyay!
Amar rabbi zera: kegon sherauhu ballayla.

Rauhu shelosha vehen bet din — yaamdu shenayim veyoshivu mechaverehem etzel hayyachid. ammay? hacha name nema: lo tehe shemia gedola meriyyay! vechi tema hacha name — kegon sherauhu ballayla hayeynu hach!

Sefa itztericha leh, deen hayyachid neeman al yede atzmo. desalka datach amena: hoil utenan dine mamonot bishlosha, veim haya mumeche lerabbim dan afillu beyachid, hacha name nikaddesheh bichidi — ka mashma lan.

Veema hacha name? en lecha mumeche lerabbim beyisrael yoter mimmoshe rabbenu, vekaamar leh hakkadosh baruch hu: ad deikka aharon bahadach, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe veel aharon beeretz mitzrayim lemor. hachodesh hazze lachem".
Lememra deed naase dayyayn? lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva, detanya: sanhedrin sherau echad sheharag et hannefesh —

a: Miktzatan naasu edim umiktzatan naasu dayyaynin, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer: kullan naasin edim, veen ed naase dayyayn.

Afillu tema rabbi akiva, ad kan la kaamar rabbi akiva hatam ella bedine nefashot, derachamana amar: "veshaftu haeda" "vehitztzilu haeda", vechevan dechazyuhu diktal nafsha la matzu chazu leh zechuta. aval hacha — afillu rabbi akiva mode.
Mishna kol hashshofarot kesherim, chutz mishshel para — mippene shehu keren. amar rabbi yose: vahalo kol hashshofarot nikreu keren, shenneemar: "bimshoch bekeren hayyovel".
Gemara shappir kaamar rabbi yose verabbanan: kol hashshofarot ikkero shofar veikkero keren. defara — keren ikkeri, shofar la ikkeri, dichtiv: "bechor shoro hadar lo vekarne reem karnav".
Verabbi yose amar lach: defara name ikkeri shofar, dichtiv: "vetitav laAdonai mishshor par", im shor — lamma par, veim par — lamma shor? ella: may "shor par" — mishshofar.
Verabbanan? kidrav matna. deamar rav matna: may "shor par" — shehu gadol kefar.
Ulla amar: hayeynu tama derabbanan, kidrav chisda. deamar rav chisda: mippene ma en kohen gadol nichnas bevigde zahav lifnay velifnim laavod avoda — lefi sheen kategor naasa sanegor.
Vela? veha ikka dam par! hoil veishtanni — ishtanni.
Veha ikka aron vechapporet ucheruv! chote bal yakriv kaamrinan.
Veha ikka kaf umachta! chote bal yitnae ka amrinan.
Veha ikka bigde zahav mibbachutz! mibbifnim ka amrinan. shofar name mibbachutz hu! kevan dilzikkaron hu — kevifnim dame.
Veha tanna "mippene shehu keren" kaamar! chada veod kaamar: chada — deen kategor naasa sanegor, veod — mippene shehu keren.
Verabbi yose? amar lach: deka amrat en kategor naasa sanegor — hane mille mibbifnim, vehay shofar mibbachutz hu. udeka amrat mippene shehu keren — kol hashshofarot name ikkero keren.
Abbaye amar, hayeynu tamayyhu derabbanan: shofar amar rachamana, velo shenayim ushelosha shofarot. veha defara, kevan dekae gilde gilde — mitchaze kishnayim ushelosha shofarot.
Veha tanna "mippene shehu keren" kaamar! chada veod kaamar: chada — deshofar echad amar rachamana, velo shenayim ushelosha shofarot. veod — mippene shehu keren.

Verabbi yose amar lach: dekaamrat "shofar echad amar rachamana, velo shenayim ushelosha shofarot" — kevan dimchabberi ahadade, chad hu. udekaamrat "mippene shehu keren" — kol hashshofarot name ikkero keren.
May mashma dehay yovela lishshana dedichra hu? detanya, amar rabbi akiva: keshehalachti laaravya, hayu korin ledichra "yovela".

Veamar rabbi akiva: keshehalachti legalya, hayu korin lenidda galmuda. may galmuda — gemula da mibbalah. veamar rabbi akiva: keshehalachti leafriki, hayu korin lemaa kesita. lemay nafka minna? lefaroshe "mea kesita" deorayyta, mea danke.
Amar rabbi: keshehalachti lichrakke hayyam, hayu korin limchira kira. lemay nafka minna? lefaroshe "asher kariti li":

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: keshehalachti litchum kan nishrayyay, hayu korin lakkalla ninfi, velattarnegol sechvi. lakkalla ninfi — may kera: "yefe nof mesos kol haaretz". velattarnegol sechvi — amar rav yehuda amar rav, veibbaet ema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may kera — "mi shat battuchot chochma o mi natan lassechvi vina". "mi shat battuchot chochma" — ellu kelayot, "o mi natan lassechvi vina" — ze tarnegol.
Levi ikkela lehahu atra. ata gavra lekammeh, amar leh:
b: Kavan pelanya. la hava yada may kaamar leh. ata sheel be midresha, amar leh: gazlan amar lach, dichtiv: "hayikba adam elohim vegomer". amar leh rava mibbarnish lerav ashe: i havay hatam, hava amena leh: hechi kavach? bemay kavach? veammay kavach? umimmela hava yadina. veihu savar: milleta deissura kaamar leh.
La havo yadi rabbanan may "serugin". shamuha leammeta deve rabbi dachazatinhu rabbanan dahavo ayyli piske piske, amara lehu: ad matay attem nichnasin serugin serugin.
La havo yadi rabbanan may "chaloglogot". yoma chad shamuha leammeta deve rabbi dachazayt lehahu gavra deka mevaddar parpechineh, amara leh: ad matay atta mefazzer chaloglogcha.
La havo yadi rabbanan may: "salseleha uterommekka". yoma chad shamuha leammeta deve rabbi dahavot amra lehahu gavra dahava ka mehappech besareh, amra leh: ad matay atta mesalsel bisarcha.
La havo yadi rabbanan may "vetetetiha bematate hashemed". yoma chad shamuha leammeta deve rabbi dahavot amra lachaverta: shekuli tatita vetati beta.

La havo yadi rabbanan may "hashelech al Adonai yehavcha vehu yechalkelecha". amar rabba bar bar chana: yoma chad hava azlina bahade hahu tayyaya, hava darena tuna vaamar li: shekol yahbaych ushedi aggamlay.
Mishna shofar shel rosh hashshana shel yael pashut ufiv metzuppe zahav, ushete chatzotzrot min hatztzedadin. shofar maarich vachatzotzrot mekatztzerot, shemmitzvat hayyom beshofar.
Uvetaaniyyot beshel zecharim kefufin, ufihen metzuppe kesef, ushete chatzotzrot baemtza. shofar mekatztzer vachatzotzrot maarichot, shemmitzvat hayyom bachatzotzrot.
Shave hayyovel lerosh hashshana lattekia velabberachot. rabbi yehuda omer: berosh hashshana tokin beshel zecharim uvayyovlot beshel yeelim.

Gemara amar rabbi levi: mitzva shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim bichfufin, veshel kol hashshana bifshutin. vehatnan: shofar shel rosh hashshana shel yael pashut! hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: berosh hashshana hayu tokin beshel zecharim kefufin, uvayyovlot beshel yeelim.
Velema hilcheta kerabbi yehuda! i amrat hilcheta kerabbi yehuda, hava amena: afillu shel yovel name kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, ka mashma lan.

Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: berosh hashshana — kamma dechayef inish dateh, tefe mealle; uveyom hakkippurim — kamma defashet inish dateh, tefe mealle. umar savar: berosh hashshana — kamma defashet inish dateh, tefe mealle; uvetaaniyyot — kamma dechayef inish dateh, tefe mealle.

a: Ufiv metzuppe zahav. vehatanya: tzippahu zahav bimkom hannachat piv — pasul, shello bimkom hannachat piv — kasher! amar abbaye: ki tenan name matnitin — shello bimkom hannachat pe tenan.

Ushete chatzotzrot min hatztzedadim. utere kale mi mishtami? vehatanya: "zachor" veshamor", bedibbur echad neemru, ma sheen happe yechola ledabber veen haozen yechola lishmoa! lechach maarich beshofar.
Lememra dechi shama sof tekia belo techillat tekia yatza, umimmela: techillat tekia belo sof tekia yatza?
Ta shema: taka barishona umashach bashsheniyya kishtayim — en beyado ella achat. ammay? tislak leh betarte! passoke tekiata mehadade la paskinan.
Ta shema: hattokea letoch habbor o letoch haddut o letoch happitas, im kol shofar shama — yatza, veim kol havara shema — lo yatza. ammay? lippok bitchillat tekia, mikkamme deliarbav kala!
Ella: tarte kale mechad gavra — la mishtami, mittere gavre — mishtami.
Umittere gavre mi mishtami? veha tanya: battora — echad kore veechad metargem, uvilvad shello yehu shenayim korin ushenayim metargemin!
Ha la damya ella lesefa: behallel uvimgilla — afillu asara korin. alma, kevan dechabbiv — yahev dateh, hacha name: kevan dechabbiv — yahev dateh veshama.
Ella lamma maarich beshofar? leda shemmitzvat hayyom beshofar.

Uvetaaniyyot beshel zecharim kefufin ufiv metzuppe kesef. may shena hatam dezahav, umay shena hacha dechesef? ibbaet ema kol kinnufeya dechesef hu, dichtiv: "ase lecha shete chatzotzrot kesef"? veibbaet ema: hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael.
Hatam name naaved dechesef! afillu hachi, kevod yom tov adif.

Rav pappa bar shemuel savar lemibad ovada kematnitin. amar leh rava: la amru ella bemikdash. tanya name hachi: bamme devarim amurim — bammikdash, aval bigvulin, makom sheyyesh chatzotzrot — en shofar, makom sheyyesh shofar — en chatzotzrot.
Vechen hinhig rabbi chalafta betzippori verabbi chananya ben teradyon besichni, ucheshebba davar etzel chachamim amru: lo hayu nohagin ken ella beshaare mizrach uvehar habbayit bilvad.

Amar rava, veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may keraa — dichtiv: "bachatzotzrot vekol shofar hariu lifne hammelech Adonai", lifne hammelech Adonai hu devaenan chatzotzrot vekol shofar, aval bealma — la.

Shave hayyovel lerosh hashshana lattekia velabberachot vechulei. amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: keman metzallenan haiddana "ze hayyom techillat maasecha zikkaron leyom rishon", keman — kerabbi eliezer, deamar: betishri nivra haolam.
Metiv rav ena: shave yovel lerosh hashshana lattekia velabberachot, veha ikka "ze hayyom techillat maasecha zikkaron leyom rishon", divrosh hashshana ita, uveyovel leta! ki katane — ashsheara.

Rav shisha bereh derav idi matne hachi, amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: ha ditnan shave hayyovel lerosh hashshana lattekia velabberachot, keman — dela kerabbi eliezer, dei rabbi eliezer, kevan deamar betishri nivra haolam, ha ikka "ze hayyom techillat maasecha zikkaron leyom rishon", divrosh hashshana ita, uvayyovel leta! ki katane ashsheara.
Mishna shofar shennisdak vedibbeko — pasul. dibbek shivre shofarot — pasul.
b: Nikkav usetamo, im meakkev et hattekia — pasul, veim lav — kasher. hattokea letoch habbor o letoch haddut o letoch happitas, im kol shofar shama — yatza, veim kol havara shama — la yatza.

Vechen mi shehaya over achore bet hakkeneset, o shehaya beto samuch levet hakkeneset, veshama kol shofar o kol megilla, im kivvevn libbo — yatza, veim lav — lo yatza. af al pi shezze shama veze shama, ze kivvevn libbo, veze lo kivvevn libbo.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: aroch vekitztzero — kasher. gerdo veheemido al gildo — kasher. tzippahu zahav bimkom hannachat pe — pasul. shello bimkom hannachat pe — kasher. tzippahu zahav mibbifnim — pasul. mibbachutz, im nishtanna kolo mikkemot shehaya — pasul, veim lav — kasher.
Nikkav usetamo, im meakkev et hattekia — pasul, veim lav — kasher. natan shofar betoch shofar, im kol penimi shama — yatza, veim kol chitzon shama — lo yatza.

Tanu rabbanan: gerdo, ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz — kasher. gerdo veheemido al gildo — kasher. hinniach shofar betoch shofar, im kol penimi shama — yatza, veim kol chitzon shama — lo yatza. hafacho vetaka bo — lo yatza.
Amar rav pappa: la tema dehafcheh kechittuna, ella shehirchiv et hakkatzar vekitztzer et harachav. may tama — kidrav matna. deamar rav matna: "vehaavarta" — derech haavarato baenan.

Dibbek shivre shofarot — pasul. tanu rabbanan: hosif alav kol shehu, ben bemino ben shello bemino — pasul. nikkav usetamo, ben bemino ben shello bemino — pasul. rabbi natan omer: bemino — kasher, shello bemino — pasul.
Bemino kasher — amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shennishtayyer rubbo. mikkelal deshello bemino, af al pi shennishtayyer rubbo — pasul.
Ikka dematne la assefa: shello bemino — pasul, amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shennifchat rubbo. mikkelal divmino, af al pi shennifchat rubbo — kasher.
Tzippahu zahav, mibbifnim — pasul. mibbachutz, im nishtanna kolo mikkemot shehaya — pasul, veim lav — kasher. nisdak leorko — pasul. lerochbo, im nishtayyer bo shiur tekia — kasher, veim lav — pasul.
Vechamma shiur tekia? peresh rabbi shimon ben gamliel: kede sheyyochazennu beyado veyerae lechan ulechan. haya kolo dak o ave o tzarur — kasher, shekkol hakkolot kesherin [beshofar].
Shelachu leh laavu dishmuel: kedacho vetaka bo — yatza. peshita, kullehu name mikdach kadchu lehu?
Amar rav ashe: shekkedacho bezachruto. mahu detema: min bemino — chotzetz, ka mashma lan.
Hattokea letoch habbor o letoch haddut kulei. amar rav huna: lo shanu ella leotan haomdim al sefat habbor, aval otan haomdin babbor — yatzu.
Tanya name hachi: hattokea letoch habbor o letoch haddut — yatza. vehatnan: lo yatza! ella lav, shema minna kidrav huna, shema minna.
Ikka derame lehu mirme. tenan: hattokea letoch habbor o letoch haddut — lo yatza. vehatanya: yatza! amar rav huna: la kashya, kan — leotan haomdin al sefat habbor, kan — leotan haomdin babbor.
Amar rabba:

a: Shama miktzat tekia babbor umiktzat tekia al sefat habbor — yatza. miktzat tekia kodem sheyyaale ammud hashshachar umiktzat tekia leachar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar — lo yatza.
Amar leh abbaye: may shena hatam — devaena kulla tekia bechiyyuva, velekka. hacha name — baena kulla tekia bechiyyuva, velekka!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam — layla lav zeman chiyyuva hu kelal, hacha — bor mekom chiyyuva hu leotan haomdin babbor.
Lememra desavar rabba: shama sof tekia belo techillat tekia — yatza, umimmela: techillat tekia belo sof tekia — yatza.
Ta shema: taka barishona, umashach bashsheniyya kishtayim — en beyado ella achat. veammay? tislak le betarte! passoke tekiata mehadade la paskinan.
Ta shema: hattokea letoch habbor o letoch haddut o letoch happitas, im kol shofar shama — yatza, veim kol havara shama — lo yatza. veammay? lippok bitchillat tekia mikkamme deliarbav kala!
Ki kaamar rabba — betokea veole lenafsheh.
I hachi, may lememra? mahu detema: zimnin demappek resheh veakkatti shofar bevor, veka miarbav kala — ka mashma lan.
Amar rav yehuda: beshofar shel ola — lo yitka, veim taka — yatza. beshofar shel shelamim — lo yitka, veim taka — lo yatza.
May tama? ola bat meila hi, kevan demaal ba — nafka la lechullin. shelamim delav bene meila ninhu — issura hu derachev behu, vela nafki lechullin.
Matkef la rava: emat maal — levatar detaka, ki ka taka — beissura taka.
Ella amar rava: echad ze veechad ze — lo yatza. hadar amar: echad ze veechad ze — yatza. mitzvot lav lehanot nittenu.
Amar rav yehuda: beshofar shel avoda zara — lo yitka, veim taka — yatza. beshofar shel ir hanniddachat — lo yitka, veim taka — lo yatza. may tama: ir hanniddachat kattote meychattat shiureh.
Amar rava: hammuddar hanaa mechavero — muttar litkoa lo tekia shel mitzva. hammuddar hanaa mishshofar — muttar litkoa bo tekia shel mitzva.

Veamar rava: hammuddar hanaa mechavero — mazze alav me chattat bimot haggeshamim, aval lo bimot hachamma. hammuddar hanaa mimmayan — tovel bo tevila shel mitzva bimot haggeshamim, aval lo bimot hachamma.

Shelachu leh laavu dishmuel: kefao veachal matztza — yatza. kefao man? ilema kefao shed, vehatanya: ittim chalim ittim shote, keshehu chalim — hare hu kefikkeach lechol devarav, keshehu shote — hare hu keshote lechol devarav!
Amar rav ashe: shekkefauhu parsiyyim. amar rava, zot omeret: hattokea lashir — yatza.
Peshita, hayeynu hach! mahu detema: hatam, echol matztza amar rachamana — veha achal,
b: Aval hacha, "zichron terua" ketiv, vehay mitassek bealma hu — ka mashma lan. alma kasavar rava: mitzvot en tzerichot kavvavna.
Etiveh: haya kore battora vehiggia zeman hammikra, im kivvevn libbo — yatza, veim lav — lo yatza. may lav, kivvevn libbo: latzet!
Lo: likrot. likrot?! ha ka kare! bekore lehaggiah.
Ta shema: haya over achore bet hakkeneset, o shehaya beto samuch levet hakkeneset, veshama kol shofar o kol megilla, im kivvevn libbo — yatza, veim lav — lo yatza. may lav, im kivvevn libbo latzet?
Lo — lishmoa. lishmoa?! veha shama! sevur, chamor bealma hu.

Etiveh: nitkavvevn shomea velo nitkavvevn mashmia, mashmia velo nitkavvevn shomea — lo yatza, ad sheyyitkavvevn shomea umashmia. bishlama nitkavvevn mashmia velo nitkavvevn shomea — kesavur chamor bealma hu, ella nitkavvevn shomea velo nitkavvevn mashmia — hechi mashkachat la? lav betokea lashir!
Dilma deka menabbach nabboche.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, hayyashen bashshemini bassukka — yilke!
Amar lo, sheani omer: mitzvot eno over alehen ella bizmannan.

Metiv rav shemen bar abba: minnayin lechohen sheole ladduchan, shello yomar: hoil venatna li tora reshut levarech et yisrael osif beracha achat mishshelli, kegon: "Adonai elohe avotechem yosef alechem" — talmud lomar: "lo tosifu al haddavar". veha hacha, kevan devarech leh — avra leh zimneh, vekatane deavar!
Hacha bemay askinan — bidla sayyem.
Vehatanya siyyem! siyyem beracha achat.
Vehatanya: siyyem kol birchotav! shane hacha, kevan deillu mitreme leh tzibbura acharina, hadar mevarech — kulleh yoma zimneh hu.
Umena temra — ditnan: hannittanin bemattana achat, shennitarvu bannittanin mattana achat — yinnatnu mattana achat. mattan arba bemattan arba — yinnatnu bemattan arba.
Mattan arba bemattan achat, rabbi eliezer omer: yinnatnu bemattan arba, rabbi yehoshua omer: yinnatnu bemattan achat.
Amar lo rabbi eliezer: hare hu over al "bal tigra"! amar lo rabbi yehoshua: hare hu over al "bal tosif"!
Amar lo rabbi eliezer: lo neemar "bal tosif" ella keshehu beatzmo. amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo neemar "bal tigra" ella keshehu beatzmo.
Veod amar rabbi yehoshua: keshello natatta — avarta al "bal tigra" velo asita maase beyadecha, keshennatatta — avarta al "bal tosif" veasita maase beyadecha.

Veha hacha, kevan deyahev leh mattana mibbechor — avra leh lezimneh, vekatane deavar mishshum "bal tosif". lav mishshum deamrinan: kevan deillu mitreme leh buchera acharina — hadar mazze minneh, kulleh yoma zimneh?!
Mimmay? dilma kasavar rabbi yehoshua mitzvot over alehen afillu shello bizmannan.

Anan hachi kaamrinan: rav shemen bar abba may tama shavek matnitin umotev mibbarayyta, lotev mimmatnitin! matnitin may tama la motev? kevan deillu mitreme leh buchera acharina bae mazze minneh — kulleh yoma zimneh hu, barayyta name, kevan dei mitreme tzibbura acharina hadar mevarech — kulleh yoma zimneh.
Verav shemen bar abba? hatam, la saggi dela yahev. hacha, i bae — mevarech, i bae — la mevarech.
Rava amar, latzet — la bae kavvavna, laavor — bae kavvavna.
Veha mattan damim lerabbi yehoshua, delaavor vela bae kavvavna! ella amar rava: latzet — la bae kavvavna. laavor, bizmanno — la bae kavvavna, shello bizmanno — bae kavvavna.
Amar leh rabbi zera leshammaeh:

a: Ikkavvavn uteka li. alma kasavar: mashmia bae kavvavna.

Metivi: haya over achore bet hakkeneset, o shehaya beto samuch levet hakkeneset, veshama kol shofar o kol megilla, im kivvevn libbo — yatza, veim lav — lo yatza. vechi kivvevn libbo may have? heach la ka mikkavven addata dideh!
Hacha bishliach tzibbur askinan, dedateh akkulleh alma.

Ta shema: nitkavvevn shomea velo nitkavvevn mashmia, nitkavvevn mashmia velo nitkavvevn shomea — lo yatza, ad sheyyitkavvevn shomea umashmia. katane mashmia domya deshomea. ma shomea — shomea leatzmo, af mashmia — mashmia leatzmo, vekatane lo yatza.
Tannae hi, detanya: shomea — shomea leatzmo, umashmia — mashmia lefi darko. amar rabbi yose: bamme devarim amurim — bishliach tzibbur, aval beyachid — la yatza, ad sheyyitkavven shomea umashmia.

Mishna "vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael vegomer", vechi yadav shel moshe osot milchama o shovrot milchama? ella lomar lach: kol zeman shehayu yisrael mistakkelin kelappe mala umeshabedin et libbam laavihem shebbashshamayim — hayu mitgabberim, veim lav — hayu noflim.

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "ase lecha saraf vesim oto al nes vehaya kol hannashuch veraa oto vachay", vechi nachash memit, o nachash mechayye? ella: bizman sheyyisrael mistakkelin kelappe mala umeshabedin et libbam laavihem shebbashshamayim — hayu mitrappein, veim lav hayu nimmokim.
Cheresh shote vekatan en motziin et harabbim yede chovatan. ze hakkelal: kol sheeno mechuyyayv baddavar — eno motzi et harabbim yede chovatan.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: hakkol chayyayvin bitkiat shofar. kohanim uleviyyim veyisreelim. gerim vaavadim meshucherarim. vetumetum veanderoginos. mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin.
Tumetum — eno motzi lo et mino, velo et sheeno mino. anderoginos — motzi et mino, aval lo et sheeno mino. mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin — eno motzi lo et mino, velo et sheeno mino.
Amar mar: hakkol chayyayvin bitkiat shofar, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. peshita! i hane la michayyeyvi — man michayyeyvi?!

Kohanim itztericha leh, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "yom terua yihye lachem", man deleteh ella bitkia dechad yoma — hu demichayyayv, vehane kohanim, hoil veitanhu bitkiot dechol hashshana, dichtiv: "utekatem bachatzotzrot al olotechem", ema la lichayyeyvu — ka mashma lan.

Mi dame? hatam chatzotzrot vehacha shofar! ella itzterich: salka datach amena, hoil utenan: shave hayyovel lerosh hashshana lattekia velabberachot, man deiteh bemitzvat hayyovel — iteh bemitzva derosh hashshana, vehane kohanim, hoil veletanhu bemitzva deyovel, ditnan: kohanim uleviyyim mochrin leolam vegoalin leolam, ema: bemitzva derosh hashshana lo lichayyeyvu — ka mashma lan.
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin — eno motzi lo et mino velo et sheeno mino. amar rav huna: uleatzmo motzi.
Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna: may shena laacherim dela — dela ate tzad avdut umappek tzad cherut, leatzmo name — la ate tzad avdut dideh umappek tzad cherut dideh.
Ella amar rav nachman: af leatzmo eno motzi. tanya name hachi: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin — af leatzmo eno motzi.
Tane ahava bereh derabbi zera: kol habberachot kullan, af al pi sheyyatza — motzi. chutz mibbirkat hallechem uvirkat hayyayin, sheim lo yatza — motzi, veim yatza — eno motzi.
Bae rava:
b: Birkat hallechem shel matztza, uvirkat hayyayin shel kiddush hayyom, mahu? kevan dechova hu — mappek, o dilma: beracha lav chova hi.
Ta shema, deamar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav pappe, hava mekaddesh lan. vechi hava ate ariseh middavra, hava mekaddesh lehu.
Tanu rabbanan: la yifros adam perusa laorchin ella im ken ochel immahem, aval pores hu levanav velivne veto kede lechannechan bemitzvot. uvehallel uvammegilla, af al pi sheyyatza — motzi.
Hadaran alach rauhu bet din

Yom tov shel rosh hashshana shechal lihyot beshabbat — bammikdash hayu tokin, aval lo bammedina. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehu tokin bechol makom sheyyesh bo bet din. amar rabbi elazar: lo hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay ella beyavne bilvad. amru lo: echad yavne, veechad kol makom sheyyesh bo bet din.
Veod zot hayta yerushalayim yetera al yavne, shekkol ir shehi roa, veshomaat, ukerova, vichola lavo — tokin. uveyavne lo hayu tokin ella bevet din bilvad.

Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi levi bar lachma amar rabbi chama bar chanina: katuv echad omer: "shabbaton zichron terua". vechatuv echad omer: "yom terua yihye lachem"! la kashya: kan — beyom tov shechal lihyot bashshabbat, kan — beyom tov shechal lihyot bachol.
Amar rava: i middeorayyta hi, bammikdash hechi takinan? veod: ha lav melacha hi, deitzterich kera lemaote.
Detana deve shemuel: "kol melechet avoda lo taasu", yatzta tekiat shofar urediyyayt happat, shehi chachma veenah melacha.

Ella amar rava: middeorayyta mishre shere, verabbanan hu digzur beh kidrabba. deamar rabba: hakkol chayyayvin bitkiat shofar, veen hakkol bekiin bitkiat shofar, gezera shemma yittelennu beyado veyelech etzel habbaki lilmod, veyaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim.
Vehayeynu tama delulav, vehayeynu tama dimgilla.

Mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay vechulei. tanu rabbanan: paam achat chal rosh hashshana lihyot beshabbat, vehayu chol hearim mitkannesin. amar lahem rabban yochanan ben zakkay livne betira: nitka! amru lo: nadun.
Amar lahem: nitka, veachar kach nadun. leachar shettaku, amru lo: nadun! amar lahem: kevar nishmea keren beyavne, veen meshivin leachar maase.
Amar rabbi elazar: lo hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay ella beyavne bilvad. amru lo: echad yavne veechad kol makom sheyyesh bo bet din. amru lo: hayeynu tanna kamma!
Ikka benayyhu be dina deakray.
Amru lo: echad yavne veechad kol makom sheyyesh bo bet din. amar rav huna:

a: Veim bet din. may veim bet din? bifne bet din, leappoke shello bifne bet din — dela.
Metiv rava: veod zot hayta yerushalayim yetera al yavne vechulei. may veod zot? illema kidkatane — "zot" mibbee leh. ella: devirushalayim tokin yechidin, uveyavne en tokin yechidin.
Uveyavne en tokin yechidin? veha ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar: ki mesayyem shelicha detzibbura tekia beyavne — la shama inish kal unne mikkal takoayya dichidae.
Ella lav: devirushalayim tokin ben bizman bet din uven shello bizman bet din, uveyavne, bizman bet din — in, shello bizman bet din — la. ha bizman bet din miha tokin, vaafillu shello bifne bet din!
La: deillu birushalayim tokin ben bifne bet din ben shello bifne bet din, uveyavne, bifne bet din — in, shello bifne bet din — la.

Ikka dematne leha derav huna aha dichtiv "beyom hakkippurim taaviru shofar bechol artzechem" — melammed shekkol yachid veyachid chayyayv litkoa. amar rav huna: veim bet din. may veim bet din — bizman bet din. leappoke shello bizman bet din, dela.

Metiv rava: tekiat rosh hashshana veyovel docha et hashshabbat bigvulin, ish uveto. may "ish uveto"? illema ish veishto — itteta mi michayyeyva? veha mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hi, vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama — nashim peturot.
Ella lav: ish beveto, vaafillu shello bizman bet din! la, leolam bizman bet din.

Metiv rav sheshet: shave hayyovel lerosh hashshana lattekia velabberachot, ella shebbayyovel tokin ben bevet din shekkiddeshu bo et hachodesh, uven bevet din shello kiddeshu bo et hachodesh, vechol yachid veyachid chayyayv litkoa. berosh hashshana lo hayu tokin ella bevet din shekkiddeshu bo et hachodesh, veen kol yachid veyachid chayyayv litkoa.

May en kol yachid veyachid chayyayv litkoa? illema devayyovel tokin yechidin uverosh hashshana en tokin yechidin — veha ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar: ki hava mesayyem shelicha detzibbura tekiata beyavne — la shama inish kal unne mikkal takoayya dichidae.

Ella lav: deillu bayyovel tokin ben bizman bet din ben shello bizman bet din, uverosh hashshana, bizman bet din — en, shello bizman bet din — la. katane mihat: bayyovel ben bizman bet din, ben shello bizman bet din!

La, leolam bizman bet din, vehachi katane: bayyovel, bizman bet din — tokin ben bifne bet din, ben shello bifne bet din. berosh hashshana, tokin bizman bet din, uvifne bet din. ittemar name: amar rabbi chiyyay bar gammada amar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rabbi: en tokin ella kol zeman shebbet din yoshvin.
Bae rabbi zera: ninaru laamod velo amdu, mahu? bet din yoshvin baenan — veha ikka, o dilma: zeman bet din baenan — velekka? teku.
Veod zot hayta yerushalayim yetera al yavne vechulei. roa — perat leyoshevet bannachal.
Shomaat — perat leyoshevet berosh hahar. kerova — perat leyoshevet chutz lattechum. vichola lavo — perat lemafsek la nahara.
Mishna barishona haya hallulav nittal bammikdash shiva, uvammedina yom echad. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe lulav nittal bammedina shiva, zecher lammikdash.
Vesheyyehe yom henef kullo asur.
Gemara umenalan deavdinan zecher lammikdash? deamar kera: "ki aale arucha lach umimmakkotayich erpaech neum Adonai ki niddacha karu lach tziyyon hi doresh en lah", mikkelal devaaya derisha.
Vesheyyehe yom henef kullo asur. may tama — mehera yibbane bet hammikdash, veyomru: eshtakad mi lo achalnu beheir mizrach — achshav name nechol.
Vela yadi deeshtakad la hava omer, heir mizrach — hittir. hasheta deikka omer — omer mattir.
Demibbene emat? illema deibbeni beshittesar, hare heir mizrach — hittir.
Ella deibbeni bachamesar. mechatzot hayyom ulehallan lishtere, deha tenan: harchokin — muttarin mechatzot hayyom ulehallan, lefi sheen bet din mitatztzelim bo!
Lo nitzrecha, deibbeni bachamesar samuch lishkiat hachamma. i name, deibbeni belelya.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: rabban yochanan ben zakkay
b: Beshitat rabbi yehuda amra, deamar: "ad etzem hayyom hazze", ad atzmo shel yom. vekasavar: ad, vead bakkelal.

Umi savar la kevoteh? veha mefalleg pelig aleh, ditnan: mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe yom henef kullo asur. amar rabbi yehuda: vahalo min hattora hu asur, dichtiv: "ad etzem hayyom hazze"!
Hatam — rabbi yehuda hu deka tae. ihu savar rabban yochanan ben zakkay midderabbanan kaamar, vela hi, middeorayyta kaamar.
Veha hitkin katane! may hitkin — darash vehitkin.
Mishna barishona hayu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom.
Paam achat nishtahu haedim millavo, venitkalkelu haleviyyim bashshir. hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelin ella ad hammincha.
Veim bau edim min hammincha ulemala — nohagin oto hayyom kodesh, ulemachar kodesh.
Mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom.
Gemara ma kilkul kilkelu haleviyyim bashshir? hacha targimu: shello amru shira kol ikkar. rabbi zera amar: sheamru shira shel chol im tamid shel ben haarbayim.

Amar lo rabbi zera leahava bereh, pok teni lehu: hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelin edut hachodesh ella kede sheyyehe shehut bayyom lehakeriv temidin umusafin veniskehem, velomar shira shello beshibbush. i amrat bishlama amur shira dechol — hayeynu deikka shibbush. ella i amrat la amur kelal — may shibbush ikka!
Kevan dela amur kelal — en lecha shibbush gadol mizze.
Metiv rav acha bar huna: tamid shel rosh hashshana shacharit karev kehilchato, bemusaf mahu omer — "hareninu lelohim uzzenu hariu lelohe yaakov", bemincha mahu omer — "kol Adonai yachil midbar".
Uvizman shechal rosh hashshana lihyot bachamishi bashshabbat, shehashshira shello "hareninu lelohim uzzenu" — lo haya omer beshacharit "hareninu", mippene shechozer vechofel et happerek.
Ella mahu omer — "hasiroti missevel shichmo". veim bau edim achar tamid shel shachar, omer "hareninu" af al pi shechozer vechofel et happerek.
I amrat bishlama, kol hecha demistappeka amrinan shira dechol — hayeynu dekaamar: omro vechoflo. ella i amrat la amur kelal — may omro vechoflo?

a: Shane hatam, deshira deyomeh hi.
Tanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi akiva: barishon ma hayu omrim — "laAdonai haaretz umeloah", al shem shekkana vehikna veshallit beolamo.
Bashsheni ma hayu omrim — "gadol Adonai umehullal meod", al shem shechillek maasav umalach alehen.

Bashshelishi hayu omrim: "elohim nitztzav baadat el", al shem sheggilla eretz bechochmato, vehechin tevel laadato. barvii hayu omrim: "el nekamot Adonai", al shem shebbara chamma ulevana, veatid lippara meovdehen.

Bachamishi hayu omrim: "hareninu lelohim uzzenu", al shem shebbara ofot vedagim leshabbeach lishmo. bashshishshi hayu omrim: "Adonai malach geut lavesh", al shem sheggamar melachto umalach alehen. bashshevii hayu omrim: "mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat", leyom shekkullo shabbat.

Amar rabbi nechemya: ma rau chachamim lechallek ben happerakim hallalu? ella: barishon — shekkana vehikna veshallit beolamo. bashsheni — shechillek maasav umalach alehem. bashshelishi — sheggilla eretz bechochmato vehechin tevel laadato.
Barvii — shebbara chamma ulevana veatid lippara meovdehen. bachamishi — shebbara ofot vedagim leshabbeach lishmo. bashshishshi — sheggamar melachto umalach alehem. bashshevii — al shem sheshshavat.

Vekamippalgi bidrav kattina, deamar rav kattina: shitta alfe shene have alma vechad charuv, shenneemar: "venisgav Adonai levaddo beyom hahu". amar abbaye: tere charuv, shenneemar: "yechayyenu miyyomayim".
Bemusefe deshabbeta ma hayu omrim? amar rav anan bar rava amar rav: "hazziv lach".
Veamar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: kederech shechalukim kan — kach chalukin bevet hakkeneset.
Beminchata deshabbeta ma hayu omrim? amar rabbi yochanan: "az yashir", umi chamocha", veaz yashir".

Ibbaya lehu: hane kullehu bechad shabbeta amri lehu, o dilma kol shabbeta veshabbeta amri chad? ta shema, detanya, amar rabbi yose: ad sheharishona omeret achat — sheniyya chozeret shetayim. shema minna kol shabbeta veshabbeta amri chad, shema minna.
Amar rav yehuda bar idde amar rabbi yochanan: eser massaot nasa shechina, mikkerae, uchenegdan galta sanhedrin, miggemara.

Eser massaot nasa shechina, mikkerae: mikkapporet lichruv, umikkeruv lichruv, umikkeruv lemiftan, umimmiftan lechatzer, umechatzer lemizbeach, umimmizbeach legag, umiggag lechoma, umechoma lair, umeir lehar, umehar lemidbar, umimmidbar alta veyashva bimkomah — shenneemar: "elech ashuva el mekomi".

Mikkapporet lichruv, mikkeruv lichruv, umikkeruv lemiftan — dichtiv: "venoadti lecha sham vedibbarti ittecha meal hakkapporet", uchetiv: "vayyirkav al keruv vayyaof", uchetiv: "uchevod elohe yisrael naala meal hakkeruv asher haya alav el miftan habbayit".
