Umimmiftan lechatzer, dichtiv: "vayyimmale habbayit et heanan vehechatzer mala et noga kevod Adonai". mechatzer lemizbeach, dichtiv: "raiti et Adonai nitztzav al hammizbeach". umimmizbeach legag, dichtiv: "tov lashevet al pinnat gag". miggag lechoma, dichtiv: "vehinne Adonai nitztzav al chomat anach". mechoma lair, dichtiv: "kol Adonai lair yikra".

Umeir lehar, dichtiv: "vayyaal kevod Adonai meal toch hair vayyaamod al hahar asher mikkedem lair". umehar lemidbar, dichtiv: "tov shevet beeretz midbar". umimmidbar alta veyashva bimkomah, dichtiv: "elech ashuva el mekomi vegomer".

Amar rabbi yochanan: shishsha chodashim nitakkeva shechina leyisrael bammidbar, shemma yachzeru bitshuva. kevan shello chazru — amar: tippach atzman, shenneemar: "veene reshaim tichlena umanos avad minhem vetikvatam mappach nafesh".
Uchenegdan galta sanhedrin, miggemara: millishkat haggazit lachanut, umechanut lirushalayim, umirushalayim leyavne,
b: Umiyyavne leusha, umeusha leyavne, umiyyavne leusha, umeusha lishfaram, umishshefaram levet shearim, umibbet shearim letzippori, umitztzippori litverya. uteverya amukka mikkullan, shenneemar: "veshafalt meeretz tedabberi".

Rabbi elazar omer: shesh galut, shenneemar: "ki heshach yoshve marom kirya nisgava yashpilenna yashpilah ad eretz yaggienna ad afar". amar rabbi yochanan: umishsham atidin liggael, shenneemar: "hitnaari meafar kumi shevi".
Mishna amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: veod zot hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheafillu rosh bet din bechol makom, shello yehu haedim holchin ella limkom havvaad.

Gemara hahi itteta deazmenuha ledina kammeh deammemar binhardea. azal ammemar lemachoza, vela azala batreh. ketav peticha illava. amar leh rav ashe leammemar, veha anan tenan: afillu rosh bet din bechol makom, shello yehu haedim holchin ella limkom havvaad!
Amar leh: hane mille leinyan edut hachodesh, deim ken nimtzeta machshilan leatid lavo. aval hacha — "eved love leish malve".
Tanu rabbanan: en kohanim rashshain laalot besandelehen ladduchan, vezo echad mittesha takkanot shehitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay. shet dehay pirka, vachada defirka kamma.
Veiddach, detanya: ger shennitgayyer bazzeman hazze, tzarich sheyyafrish rova lekinno. amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: kevar nimna aleha rabban yochanan uvittelah, mippene hattakkala.
Veiddach pelugeta derav pappa verav nachman bar yitzchak. rav pappa amar: kerem revai, rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: lashon shel zehorit.

Rav pappa amar: kerem revai, detanya: kerem revai haya ole lirushalayim mahalach yom lechol tzad, vezo hi techumah: elat min hatztzafon, veakrabbat min haddarom, lod min hammaarav, veyarden min hammizrach.
Veamar ulla, veittema rabba bar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: ma taam — kede leatter shuke yerushalayim beferot.
Vetanya: kerem revai haya lo lerabbi eliezer bemizrach lod betzad kefar tavi, uvikkesh rabbi eliezer lehafekiro laaniyyim.
Amru lo talmidav: rabbi, kevar nimnu chaverecha alav vehittiruhu. man chaverecha — rabban yochanan ben zakkay.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: lashon shel zehorit, detanya: barishona hayu koshrin lashon shel zehorit al petach ulam mibbachutz, hilbin — hayu semechin, lo hilbin — hayu atzevin, hitkinu sheyyehu koshrin oto al petach ulam mibbifnim.
Vaadayin hayu metzitzin veroin, hilbin — hayu semechin, lo hilbin — hayu atzevin, hitkinu sheyyehu koshrin oto chetzyo bassela vechetzyo ben karnav shel sair hammishtalleach.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak may tama la amar kerav pappa? amar lach: i salka datach rabban yochanan ben zakkay, chaverav derabbi eliezer mi hava? rabbo hava. veiddach? kevan detalmidim havo — lav orach ara lememra leh lerabbeh "rabbach".

Verav pappa may tama la amar kerav nachman bar yitzchak? amar lach: i salka datach rabban yochanan ben zakkay — bime rabban yochanan ben zakkay mi hava lashon shel zehorit? vehatanya: kol shenotav shel rabban yochanan ben zakkay mea veesrim shana. arbaim shana — asak bifrakmatya, arbaim shana — lamad, arbaim shana — limmed.

Vetanya: arbaim shana kodem shennecherav habbayit lo haya lashon shel zehorit malbin ella maadim. utenan: mishshecharav habbayit hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay! veiddach: otam arbaim shana delamad — talmid yoshev lifne rabbo hava, vaamar milleta veistabbar tameh.

a: Vekaveh rabbeh bishmeh.
Mishna seder berachot: omer avot ugevurot ukedushshat hashshem, vecholel malchiyyot immahen, veeno tokea.
Kedushshat hayyom vetokea, zichronot vetokea, shofarot vetokea, veomer avoda vehodaa uvirkat kohanim, divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri.

Amar lo rabbi akiva: im eno tokea lemalchiyyot — lama hu mazkir? ella: omer avot ugevurot ukedushshat hashshem, vecholel malchiyyot im kedushshat hayyom vetokea, zichronot vetokea, shofarot vetokea, veomer avoda vehodaa uvirkat kohanim.
Gemara amar lo rabbi akiva: im eno tokea lemalchiyyot — lama hu mazkir? lama hu mazkir?! rachamana amar aydkar! ella: lama eser? lema tesha, dehoil veishtanni ishtanni!

Tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheomrim avot — shenneemar: "havu laAdonai bene elim". uminnayin sheomrim gevurot — shenneemar: "havu laAdonai kavod vaoz". uminnayin sheomrim kedushshot — shenneemar: "havu laAdonai kevod shemo hishtachavu laAdonai behaderat kodesh".

Uminnayin sheomrim malchiyyot zichronot veshofarot — rabbi eliezer omer: dichtiv "shabbaton zichron terua mikra kodesh". "shabbaton" — ze kedushshat hayyom; "zichron" — ellu zichronot; "terua" — ellu shofarot; "mikra kodesh" — kaddeshehu baasiyyayt melacha.

Amar lo rabbi akiva: mippene ma lo nomar "shabbaton" — shevut, shebbo patach hakkatuv techilla! ella: "shabbaton" — kaddeshehu baasiyyayt melacha; "zichron" — ellu zichronot; "terua" — ellu shofarot; "mikra kodesh" — zo kedushshat hayyom.
Minnayin sheomrim malchiyyot? tanya, rabbi omer: "ani Adonai elohechem", ubbachodesh hashshevii" — zo malchut.

Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "vehayu lachem lezikkaron lifne elohechem", sheen talmud lomar "ani Adonai elohechem", uma talmud lomar "ani Adonai elohechem" — ze bana av lechol makom shenneemar bo zichronot — yihyu malchiyyot immahen.
Vehechan omrah likdushshat hayyom? tanya, rabbi omer: im hammalchiyyot omrah. ma matzinu bechol makom barviit — af kan barviit.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im hazzichronot omrah. ma matzinu bechol makom baemtza — af kan baemtza.

Ucheshekkiddeshu bet din et hashshana beusha, yarad rabbi yochanan ben beroka lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel, veasa kerabbi yochanan ben nuri. amar lo rabban shimon: lo hayu nohagin ken beyavne. layyom hashsheni yarad rabbi chanina beno shel rabbi yose haggelili veasa kerabbi akiva. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: kach hayu nohagin beyavne.

Lememra derabban shimon ben gamliel kerabbi akiva sevira leh? veha amar rabbi akiva: malchiyyot im kedushshat hayyom amar lehu, verabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kedushshat hayyom im hazzichronot amar lehu? amar rabbi zera: lomar shettokin lemalchiyyot.

Layyom hashsheni yarad rabbi chanina. may sheni? illema yom tov sheni — lememra deabberu leelul?! vehaamar rabbi chanina bar kahana: mimot ezra veelach lo matzinu elul meubbar! amar rav chisda: may sheni — leyom sheni, lashshana habbaa.
Mishna en pochatin measara malchiyyot, measara zichronot, measara shofarot. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: im amar shalosh shalosh mikkullan — yatza.
Gemara hane asara malchiyyot keneged mi? amar rabbi: keneged asara hillulim sheamar david besefer tehillim. hillulim tuva havu! hanach dichtiv behu "haleluhu beteka shofar".
Rav yosef amar: keneged aseret haddibberot shenneemru lo lemoshe besinay. rabbi yochanan amar: keneged asara maamarot shebbahen nivra haolam. he ninhu? "vayyomer" —
"Vayyomer" divreshit tisha havu! "bereshit" name maamar hu, dichtiv: "bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu".

Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: im amar shalosh shalosh mikkullan — yatza. ibbaya lehu, hechi katane: shalosh min hattora, shalosh min hanneviim, veshalosh min hakketuvim — dehavu tesha, veikka benayyhu chada, o dilma: echad min hattora, veechad min hanneviim, veechad min hakketuvim — dehavyayn lehu shalosh, veikka benayyhu tuva?
Ta shema, detanya: en pochatin measara malchiyyot, measara zichronot, measara shofarot, veim amar sheva mikkullan — yatza, keneged shiva rekiim.

Rabbi yochanan ben nuri amar: happochet — lo yifchot mishsheva, veim amar shalosh mikkullan — yatza, keneged tora neviim uchetuvim, veamri la: keneged kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. amar rav huna amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri.
Mishna en mazkirin zikkaron malchut veshofar shel pureanut. matchil battora, umashlim bannavi, rabbi yose omer: im hishlim battora — yatza.
b: Gemara malchiyyot, kegon: "chay ani neum Adonai [elohim] im lo beyad chazaka uvizroa netuya uvechema shefucha emloch alechem", veaf al gav deamar rav nachman: kol ki hay ritcha lirtach kudesha berich hu alan velifrokinan, kevan divritcha amur — adkore ritcha beresh shatta la madkerinan.
Zikkaron — kegon: "vayyizkor ki vasar hemma vegomer" shofar — kegon: "tiku shofar baggiva vegomer".

Aval im ba lomar malchut zikkaron veshofar shel pureanut shel nochrim, omer. malchut — kegon: "Adonai malach yirgezu ammim, uchegon: "Adonai melech olam vaed avdu goyim meartzo". zikkaron — kegon: "zechor Adonai livne edom vegomer". shofar — kegon: "vaAdonai elohim bashshofar yitka vehalach besaarot teman", uchetiv: "Adonai tzevaot yagen alehem".
En mazkirin zikkaron shel yachid, vaafillu letova, kegon: "zochreni Adonai birtzon ammecha", uchegon: "zochra li elohay letova".
Pikdonot — hare hen kezichronot, kegon: "vaAdonai pakad et sara", uchegon: "pakod pakadti etchem", divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: enan kezichronot.
Ulerabbi yose nehi name defikdonot hare hen kezichronot, "vaAdonai pakad et sara" — pikkadon deyachid hu! kevan deatu rabbim minna — kerabbim damya.

"Seu shearim rashechem vehinnasu pitche olam veyavo melech hakkavod. mi ze melech hakkavod Adonai izzuz vegibbor Adonai gibbor milchama. seu shearim rashechem useu pitche olam veyavo melech hakkavod. mi hu ze melech hakkavod Adonai tzevaot hu melech hakkavod sela". rishona — shetayim, sheniyya — shalosh, divre rabbi yose.
Rabbi yehuda omer: rishona — achat, sheniyya — shetayim.

"Zammeru elohim zammeru zammeru lemalkenu zammeru. ki melech kol haaretz elohim" — shetayim, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: achat. veshavin bemalach elohim al goyim elohim yashav al kisse kodsho", shehi achat.
Zichron sheyyesh bo terua — kegon: "shabbaton zichron terua mikra kodesh" — omrah im hazzichronot veomrah im hashshofarot, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: eno omrah ella im hazzichronot bilvad.

Malchut sheyyesh immo terua — kegon: "Adonai elohav immo uteruat melech bo" — omrah im hammalchiyyot veomrah im hashshofarot, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: eno omrah ella im hammalchiyyot bilvad.
Terua sheen immah lo kelum — kegon: "yom terua yihye lachem" — omrah im hashshofarot, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: eno omrah kol ikkar.

Matchil battora umashlim benavi, rabbi yose omer: im hishlim battora — yatza. "im hishlim", diavad — in, lechattechilla — la. vehatanya, rabbi yose omer: hammashlim battora — hare ze meshubbach! ema: "mashlim".

Veha "im hishlim" katane, diavad — in, lechattechilla — la! hachi kaamar: matchil battora umashlim benavi. rabbi yose omer: mashlim battora, veim hishlim benavi — yatza. tanya name hachi, amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose: votikin hayu mashlimin otah battora.

Bishlama zichronot veshofarot ikka tuva, ella malchiyyot — telat hu dehavyayn: "Adonai elohav immo uteruat melech bo", "vayhi bishurun melech", "Adonai yimloch leolam vaed", vaanan baenan eser, velekka!
Amar rav huna, ta shema: "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad" — malchut, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: enah malchut.

"Veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha ki Adonai hu haelohim en od" — malchut, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: enah malchut. "atta horeta ladaat ki Adonai hu haelohim en od milvaddo" — malchut, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yehuda omer: enah malchut.
Mishna haover lifne hatteva beyom tov shel rosh hashshana, hashsheni matkia. uvishat hahallel, harishon makre et hahallel.
Gemara may shena sheni matkia — mishshum divrov am haderat melech", i hachi hallel name — nema bashsheni mishshum divrov am haderat melech"!
Ella: may shena hallel devarishon — mishshum dizrizin makdimin lemitzvot, tekia name naaved barishon, mishshum dizrizin makdimin lemitzvot!
Amar rabbi yochanan: bishat hashshemad shanu.

Middekaamar "bishat hallel", mikkelal divrosh hashshana lekka hallel. may tama? amar rabbi avahu: amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam! mippene ma en yisrael omrim shira lefanecha berosh hashshana uveyom hakkippurim? amar lahem: efshar melech yoshev al kisse din, vesifre chayyim vesifre metim petuchin lefanav — veyisrael omrim shira?!

Mishna shofar shel rosh hashshana en maavirin alav et hattechum, veen mefakkechin alav et haggal. lo olin bailan, velo rochvin al gabbe vehema, velo shatin al pene hammayim, veen chotchin oto — ben bedavar shehu mishshum shevut, uven bedavar shehu mishshum lo taase. aval im ratza litten letocho mayim o yayin — yitten.
En meakkevin et hattinokot millitkoa, aval mitassekin immahen ad sheyyilmedu. vehammitassek — lo yatza, vehashshomea min hammitassek — lo yatza.
Gemara may tama? shofar ase hu, veyom tov ase velo taase — veen ase doche et lo taase vaase.
Lo olin bailan velo rochvin al gabbe behema vechulei. hasheta derabbanan amrat la, deorayyta mibbaya?! zo veen tzarich lomar zo katane.

a: Veen chotchin oto, ben bedavar shehu mishshum shevut uven bedavar shehu mishshum lo taase. mishshum shevut — maggala. lo taase — sakkina.
Hasheta mishshum shevut amrat la — lo taase mibbaya? zo veen tzarich lomar zo katane.
Aval im ratza litten letocho mayim o yayin — yitten. mayim o yayin — en, me raglayim — la.
Matnitin manni — abba shaul hi. detanya, abba shaul omer: mayim o yayin — muttar, kede letzachtzecho. me raglayim — asur, mippene hakkavod.

En meakkevin et hattinokot millitkoa. ha nashim — meakkevin, vehatanya: en meakkevin lo et hannashim velo et hattinokot millitkoa beyom tov! amar abbaye, la kashya: ha rabbi yehuda, ha rabbi yose verabbi shimon.
Detanya: "dabber el bene yisrael". bene yisrael somchin, veen benot yisrael somchot, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: nashim somchot — reshut.

Aval mitassekin bahem ad sheyyilmedu. amar rabbi elazar: afillu beshabbat. tanya name hachi: mitassekin bahen ad sheyyilmedu, afillu beshabbat. veen meakkevin hattinokot millitkoa beshabbat, veen tzarich lomar beyom tov.

Ha gufa kashya, amrat: mitassekin bahen ad sheyyilmedu, vaafillu beshabbat — alma lechattechilla amrinan tiku. vahadar tana: en meakkevin — ikkuva hu dela meakkevin, ha lechattechilla la amrinan tiku!
La kashya: kan
b: Bekatan shehiggia lechinnuch, kan bekatan shello higgia lechinnuch.
Vehammitassek lo yatza. ha tokea lashir — yatza. lema mesayyay leh lerava, deamar rava: hattokea lashir — yatza. dilma tokea lashir — name mitassek kare leh.
Vehashshomea min hammitassek — lo yatza. aval hashshomea min hammashmia leatzmo, may? yatza. lema tehve teyuveteh derabbi zera, deamar leh rabbi zera leshammaeh: ikkavvavn uteka li!
Dilma ayyeyde ditna resha mitassek, tena sefa name mitassek.
Mishna seder tekiot: shalosh shel shalosh shalosh. shiur tekia keshalosh teruot, shiur terua keshalosh yevavot. taka barishona umashach bashsheniyya kishtayim — en beyado ella achat.
Mi shebberach veachar kach nitmanna lo shofar — tokea umeria vetokea shalosh peamim.
Keshem sheshsheliach tzibbur chayyayv, kach kol yachid veyachid chayyayv. rabban gamliel omer: sheliach tzibbur motzi et harabbim yede chovatan.
Gemara vehatanya: shiur tekia kitrua! amar abbaye: tanna didan ka chashev tekia dechullehu bave uteruot dechullehu bave. tanna bara ka chashev chad bava vetu la.
Shiur terua kishlosh yevavot. vehatanya: shiur terua kishlosha shevarim!

Amar abbaye: beha vadday peligi, dichtiv: "yom terua yihye lachem", umetargeminan: "yom yabbava yehe lechon". uchetiv beimmeh desisra: "bead hachallon nishkefa vatteyabbev em sisra". mar savar gannoche gannach. umar savar yallole yallel.
Tanu rabbanan: minnayin shebbeshofar? talmud lomar: "vehaavarta shofar terua".

En li ella bayyovel, berosh hashshana minnayin? talmud lomar: "bachodesh hashshevii", sheen talmud lomar "bachodesh hashshevii", uma talmud lomar "bachodesh hashshevii" — sheyyihyu kol teruot shel chodesh shevii ze kaze.
Uminnayin sheppeshuta lefaneha — talmud lomar: "vehaavarta shofar terua". uminnayin sheppeshuta leachareha — talmud lomar: "taaviru shofar".
Veen li ella bayyovel, berosh hashshana minnayin? talmud lomar: "bachodesh hashshevii".

a: Sheen talmud lomar "bachodesh hashshevii", uma talmud lomar "bachodesh hashshevii" — sheyyehu kol teruot hachodesh hashshevii ze kaze.
Uminnayin leshalosh shel shalosh shalosh — talmud lomar: "vehaavarta shofar terua", "shabbaton zichron terua", "yom terua yihye lachem".
Uminnayin litten et haamur shel ze baze veshel ze baze — talmud lomar: "shevii" "shevii" ligzera shava.
Ha ketzad? shalosh shehen tesha. shiur tekia kitrua, shiur terua kishlosha shevarim.
Hay tanna, meikkara mayyte la behekkesha, vehasheta mayyte la bigzera shava? hachi kaamar: i lav gezera shava, hava mayytina la behekkesha. hasheta deatya bigzera shava — hekkesha la tzerich.

Vehay tanna mayyte la bigzera shava mimmidbar, detanya: "utekatem terua" — tekia bifne atzmah uterua bifne atzmah. atta omer tekia bifne atzmah uterua bifne atzmah, o eno ella tekia uterua achat hi — keshehu omer: "uvehakhil et hakkahal titkeu velo tariu", heve omer: tekia bifne atzmah uterua bifne atzmah.
Uminnayin sheppeshuta lefaneha — talmud lomar: "utekatem terua". uminnayin sheppeshuta leachareha — talmud lomar: "terua yitkeu".

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "utekatem terua shenit", sheen talmud lomar "shenit", uma talmud lomar "shenit" — ze bana av, shekkol makom shenneemar "terua" — tehe tekia sheniyya lah. en li ella bammidbar, berosh hashshana minnayin? talmud lomar: "terua" "terua" ligzera shava.
Veshalosh teruot neemru berosh hashshana: "shabbaton zichron terua", "yom terua", "vehaavarta shofar terua", ushete tekiot lechol achat veachat.

Matzinu lemedin: shalosh teruot veshesh tekiot neemru berosh hashshana, shetayim middivre tora, veachat middivre sofrim. "shabbaton zichron terua", "vehaavarta shofar terua" — middivre tora. "yom terua yihye lachem" — letalmudo hu ba.

Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: achat middivre tora, ushetayim middivre sofrim. "vehaavarta shofar terua" — middivre tora. "shabbaton zichron terua", veyom terua yihye lachem" — letalmudo hu ba.
May letalmudo hu ba? mibbee: bayyom velo ballayla.
Veiddach, bayyom velo ballayla mena leh? nafka leh mibbeyom hakkippurim".
I "beyom hakkippurim" yalef, nigmor name minneh lifshuta lefaneha ufeshuta leachareha! "vehaavarta" "taaviru" la mashma lehu.
Ella may darshi behu? "vehaavarta" kidrav matna. deamar rav matna: "vehaavarta" — derech haavarato, "taaviru" — dekaamar rachamana neabbereh beyad.
Veiddach? derav matna — middeshanni bedibbureh.

"Taaviru" beyad — la matzet amrat, degamar "avara" "avara" mimmoshe. ketiv hacha: "vehaavarta shofar terua", uchetiv hatam: "vaytzav moshe vayyaaviru kol bammachane", ma lehallan bekol — af kan bekol.
Ulehay tanna demayyte la mimmidbar, i ma lehallan chatzotzrot, af kan chatzotzrot?
Talmud lomar: "tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu", e zehu chag shehachodesh mitkasse bo? heve omer ze rosh hashshana, vekaamar rachamana: "shofar".
Atken rabbi avahu bekesari: tekia, shelosha shevarim, terua, tekia. ma nafshach? i yallole yallel — lebed tekia terua utekia, vei gannoche gannach — lebed tekia shelosha shevarim utekia!

Mesappeka leh i gannoche gannach i yallole yallel. matkef la rav avvira: vedilma yallole hava, veka mafsek shelosha shevarim ben terua litkia! dahadar aved tekia terua utekia. matkef la ravina: vedilma gannoche hava, veka mafseka terua ben shevarim litkia! dahadar aved tekia shevarim tekia.
Ella rabbi avahu may atken? i gannoche gannach — ha avdeh, i yallole yallel — ha avdeh! mesappeka leh dilma gannach veyallel.
I hachi, lebad name ippecha: tekia, terua, shelosha shevarim, utekia — dilma yallel vegannach! setama demilleta, ki mittera beinish milleta — beresha ganach vahadar yalel.
Taka barishona umashach bashsheniyya kishtayim. amar rabbi yochanan: shama
b: Tesha tekiot betesha shaot bayyom — yatza.
Tanya name hachi: shama tesha tekiot betesha shaot bayyom — yatza. mittisha bene adam keechad — lo yatza. tekia mizze uterua mizze — yatza. vaafillu beserugin, vaafillu kol hayyom kullo.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: behallel uvimgilla, im shaha kede ligmor et kullah — chozer larosh! la kashya: ha dideh, ha derabbeh.

Vedideh la? veha rabbi avahu hava shakel veazel batreh derabbi yochanan vahava kare keriat shema, ki meta limvoot metunnafot, ishtik, batar dachalef amar leh: mahu ligmor? amar lo: im shahita kede ligmor et kullah — chazor larosh.
Hachi kaamar leh: ledidi — la sevira li, ledidach, disvira lach: im shahita kede ligmor et kullah — chazor larosh.
Tanu rabbanan: tekiot — en meakkevot zo et zo. berachot — en meakkevot zo et zo. tekiot uverachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim — meakkevot.

May tama? amar rabba: amar hakkadosh baruch hu, imru lefanay berosh hashshana malchiyyot zichronot veshofarot, malchiyyot — kede shettamlichuni alechem, zichronot — kede sheyyavo lefanay zichronechem letova, uvamme — beshofar.
Mi shebberach veachar kach nitmanna lo shofar — tokea umeria vetokea. tama dela hava leh shofar meikkara, ha hava leh shofar meikkara, ki shama lehu — asseder berachot shama lehu.
Rav pappa bar shemuel kam letzalloye, amar leh leshammaeh: ki nahayrna lach teka li. amar leh rava: lo amru ella bechever ir.

Tanya name hachi: keshehu shoman — shoman al hasseder, veal seder berachot. bamme devarim amurim — bechever ir, aval shello bechever ir — shoman al hasseder veshello al seder berachot. veyachid shello taka — chavero tokea lo, veyachid shello berach — en chavero mevarech alav.
Umitzva betokin yoter min hamevarchin. ketzad? shete ayayrot, beachat tokin, uveachat mevarchin — holchin limkom shettokin, veen holchin limkom shemmevarchin.
Peshita — ha deorayyta, ha derabbanan! la tzericha, deaf al gav deha vadday veha safek.

Keshem sheshsheliach tzibbur chayyayv, kach kol yachid veyachid vechulei. tanya, amru lo lerabban gamliel: lidvarecha, lamma tzibbur mitpallelin! amar lahem: kede lehasedir sheliach tzibbur tefillato,
Amar lahem rabban gamliel: ledivrechem, lamma sheliach tzibbur yored lifne hatteva? amru lo: kede lehotzi et sheeno baki. amar lahem: keshem shemmotzi et sheeno baki, kach motzi et habbaki.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: modim chachamim lerabban gamliel. verav amar: adayin hi machloket. shama rabbi chiyyay bereh derabba bar nachmani, azal, amra lishmata kammeh derav dimi bar chinnana. amar leh, hachi amar rav: adayin hi machloket. amar leh: rabba bar bar chana name hachi kaamar. ki amar rabbi yochanan leha shemata, ippelig aleh resh lakish vaamar: adayin hi machloket.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi chana tzipporaa amar rabbi yochanan: hilcheta kerabban gamliel, hilcheta mikkelal difligi!

a: Ki selek rabbi abba miyyamme, persha: modim chachamim lerabban gamliel bivrachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim, vahalacha mikkelal difligi bivrachot dechol hashshana.
Ini?! vehaamar rabbi chana tzipporaa amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabban gamliel bivrachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim!
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: man modim — rabbi meir, vahalacha mikkelal difligi — rabbanan.

Detanya: berachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim — sheliach tzibbur motzi harabbim yede chovatan, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: keshem sheshsheliach tzibbur chayyayv — kach kol yachid veyachid chayyayv.
May shena hane? illema mishshum dinfishi kerae — vehaamar rav chananel amar rav: kevan sheamar "uvetoratcha katuv lemor" shuv eno tzarich! ella mishshum deavvshi berachot.

Gufa, amar rav chananel amar rav: kevan sheamar "uvetoratcha katuv lemor" — shuv eno tzarich. sevur minna: hane mille beyachid, aval betzibbur la. ittemar, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: echad yachid echad tzibbur, kevan sheamar "uvetoratcha katuv lemor" — shuv eno tzarich.

Amar rabbi elazar: leolam yasdir adam tefillato, veachar kach yitpallel. amar rabbi abba: mistabbera milleteh derabbi elazar bivrachot shel rosh hashshana veshel yom hakkippurim veshel perakim, aval dechol hashshana — la.
Ini?! veha rav yehuda mesaddar tzeloteh umetzalle! shane rav yehuda, kevan demittelatin yomin litlatin yomin hava metzalle, kifrakim dame.
Amar rav acha bar avvira amar rabbi shimon chasida: poter haya rabban gamliel afillu am shebbassadot. vela mibbaya hane dekayymi hacha?!
Adderabba: hane anisi, hane la anisi,
Detane abba bereh derav binyamin bar chiyyay: am sheachore kohanim — enan bichlal beracha.
Ella, ki ata ravin: amar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi shimon chasida: lo patar rabban gamliel ella am shebbassadot, may tama — mishshum daanisi bimlacha, aval bair — lo.
Haderan alach yom tov uselika la massechet rosh hashshana
Meematay mazkirin gevurot geshamim? rabbi eliezer omer: miyyom tov harishon shel chag. rabbi yehoshua omer: miyyom tov haacharon shel chag.

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: hoil veen haggeshamim ella siman kelala bechag, lama hu mazkir? amar lo rabbi eliezer: af ani lo amarti lishol ella lehazekir "mashshiv haruach umorid haggeshem" beonato. amar lo: im ken, leolam yehe mazkir!

En shoalim et haggeshamim ella samuch laggeshamim. rabbi yehuda omer: haover lifne hatteva beyom tov haacharon shel chag — haacharon mazkir, harishon eno mazkir. beyom tov rishon shel pesach — harishon mazkir, haacharon eno mazkir.
Gemara tanna hecha kae dekatane "meematay"? tanna hatam kae —
Dekatane: mazkirim gevurot geshamim bitchiyyayt hammetim, veshoalin bevirkat hashshanim, vehavedala bechonen haddaat. vekatane: meematay mazkirim gevurot geshamim.
Velitne hatam! may shena deshavkeh ad hacha?!
Ella, tanna merosh hashshana salek, ditnan: uvechag niddonin al hammayim. veayyeyde ditna uvechag niddonim al hammayim, tana meematay mazkirin gevurot geshamim.

Velitne "meematay mazkirim al haggeshamim". may "gevurot geshamim"? amar rabbi yochanan: mippene sheyyordin bigvura, shenneemar: "ose gedolot ad en cheker veniflaot ad en mispar", uchetiv: "hannoten matar al pene haaretz vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot".
May mashma? amar rabba bar shela: atya "cheker" "cheker" mibberiyyayto shel olam.

Ketiv hacha: "ose gedolot ad en cheker", uchetiv hatam: "halo yadata im lo shamata elohe olam Adonai bore ketzot haaretz lo yiaf velo yiga en cheker litvunato", uchetiv: "mechin harim bechocho nezar bigvura".

Umena lan devitfilla — detanya: "leahava et Adonai elohechem uleovdo bechol levavchem", ezo hi avoda shehi ballev — heve omer: zo tefilla. uchetiv batreh: "venatatti metar artzechem beitto yore umalkosh".
Amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha maftechot beyado shel hakkadosh baruch hu shello nimseru beyad shaliach, veellu hen: mafteach shel geshamim, mafteach shel chayya, umafteach shel techiyyayt hammetim.
Mafteach shel geshamim — dichtiv: "yiftach Adonai lecha et otzaro hattov et hashshamayim latet metar artzecha beitto". mafteach shel chayya minnayin — dichtiv: "vayyizkor elohim et rachel vayyishma
b: Eleha elohim vayyiftach et rachmah". mafteach shel techiyyayt hammetim minnayin — dichtiv: "vidatem ki ani Adonai befitchi et kivrotechem".
Bemareva amri: af mafteach shel parnasa, dichtiv: "poteach et yadecha vegomer". verabbi yochanan, may tama la ka chashev leha? amar lach: geshamim hayeynu parnasa.
Rabbi eliezer omer: miyyom tov harishon shel chag kulei. ibbaya lehu: rabbi eliezer mehecha gamayr la? millulav gamar la, o minnissuch hammayim gamar la.
Millulav gamar la: ma lulav bayyom — af hazekara bayyom. o dilma minnissuch hammayim gamar la: ma nissuch hammayim meureta, deamar mar: "uminchatam veniskehem", afillu ballayla — af hazekara meureta.
Ta shema, deamar rabbi avahu: lo lemadah rabbi eliezer ella millulav. ikka deamri: rabbi avahu gemara gemir la, veikka deamri: matnita shemia leh.
May hi — detanya: meematay mazkirin al haggeshamim? rabbi eliezer omer: mishsheat netilat lulav. rabbi yehoshua omer: mishsheat hannachato.
Amar rabbi eliezer: hoil vearbaat minin hallalu enan bain ella leratztzot al hammayim, ucheshem shearba minin hallalu i efshar bahem belo mayim — kach i efshar laolam belo mayim.

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: vahalo geshamim bechag eno ella siman kelala! amar lo rabbi eliezer: af ani lo amarti lishol, ella lehazekir. ucheshem shettechiyyayt hammetim mazkir kol hashshana kullah veenah ella bizmannah, kach mazkirin gevurot geshamim kol hashshana veenan ella bizmannan. lefichach, im ba lehazekir kol hashshana kullah — mazkir. rabbi omer, omer ani: mishshaa shemmafsik lishela — kach mafsik lehazekara.

Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: bashsheni bechag hu mazkir, rabbi akiva omer: bashshishshi bechag hu mazkir. rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi yehoshua omer: haover lifne hatteva beyom tov haacharon shel chag — haacharon mazkir, harishon eno mazkir. beyom tov rishon shel pesach — harishon mazkir, haacharon eno mazkir.
Shappir kaamar leh rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua! amar lecha rabbi yehoshua: bishlama techiyyayt hammetim mazkir, dechulle yoma zimneh hu.
Ella geshamim, kol emat deatayin zimnayyhu hi?! vehatnan: yatza nisan veyardu geshamim — siman kelala hem, shenneemar: "halo ketzir chittim hayyom vegomer".
Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: bashsheni bechag hu mazkir. may tama derabbi yehuda ben betira? detanya, rabbi yehuda ben betira omer:
Neemar bashsheni "veniskehem", veneemar bashshishshi "unesacheha", veneemar bashshevii "kemishpatam",
Hare mem yod mem, hare kan mayim — mikkan remez lenissuch hammayim min hattora.
Umay shena besheni denaket, dechi remizi lehu bikra — besheni hu dirmizi, hilkach besheni madkerinan.
Rabbi akiva omer: bashshishshi bechag hu mazkir, shenneemar bashshishshi: "unesacheha", bishne nissuchin hakkatuv medabber — echad nissuch hammayim, veechad nissuch hayyayin.
Ema tarvayyhu dechamra! savar la kerabbi yehuda ben betira, deamar: remizi mayya.
